entries.name: TwoHDM.fieldCompMatrix
entries.docstring: The 2 x 2 complex matrices made up of components of the two Higgs fields.
entries.snippet: def fieldCompMatrix (Φ1 Φ2 : HiggsField) (x : SpaceTime) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ

entries.name: TwoHDM.prodMatrix_eq_fieldCompMatrix_sq
entries.docstring: The matrix `prodMatrix Φ1 Φ2 x` is equal to the square of `fieldCompMatrix Φ1 Φ2 x`.
entries.snippet:
lemma prodMatrix_eq_fieldCompMatrix_sq (Φ1 Φ2 : HiggsField) (x : SpaceTime) :
    prodMatrix Φ1 Φ2 x = fieldCompMatrix Φ1 Φ2 x * (fieldCompMatrix Φ1 Φ2 x).conjTranspose

entries.name: TwoHDM.prodMatrix_posSemiDef
entries.docstring: The matrix `prodMatrix` is positive semi-definite.

    (prodMatrix Φ1 Φ2 x).PosSemidef

entries.name: TwoHDM.prodMatrix_invariant
entries.snippet:
informal_lemma prodMatrix_invariant where
  math :≈ "The map ``prodMatrix is invariant under the simultanous action of ``gaugeAction
    on the two Higgs fields."
  deps :≈ [``prodMatrix, ``gaugeAction]

entries.name: TwoHDM.prodMatrix_to_higgsField
entries.snippet:
informal_lemma prodMatrix_to_higgsField where
  math :≈ "Given any smooth map ``f from spacetime to 2 x 2 complex matrices landing on positive
    semi-definite matrices, there exist smooth Higgs fields ``Φ1 and ``Φ2 such that
    ``f is equal to ``prodMatrix Φ1 Φ2."
  deps :≈ [``prodMatrix, ``HiggsField, ``prodMatrix_smooth]
  ref :≈ "https://arxiv.org/pdf/hep-ph/0605184"

entries.name: HepLean.Fin.predAboveI
entries.docstring:
Given a `i` and `x` in `Fin n.succ.succ` returns an element of `Fin n.succ`
  subtracting 1 if `i.val ≤ x.val` else casting x.
entries.snippet: def predAboveI (i x : Fin n.succ.succ) : Fin n.succ

entries.name: HepLean.Fin.predAboveI_self
entries.snippet: lemma predAboveI_self (i : Fin n.succ.succ) : predAboveI i i = ⟨i.val - 1, by omega⟩

entries.name: HepLean.Fin.predAboveI_succAbove
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma predAboveI_succAbove (i : Fin n.succ.succ) (x : Fin n.succ) :
    predAboveI i (Fin.succAbove i x) = x

entries.name: HepLean.Fin.succsAbove_predAboveI
entries.snippet:
lemma succsAbove_predAboveI {i x : Fin n.succ.succ} (h : i ≠ x) :
    Fin.succAbove i (predAboveI i x) = x

entries.name: HepLean.Fin.predAboveI_eq_iff
entries.snippet:
lemma predAboveI_eq_iff {i x : Fin n.succ.succ} (h : i ≠ x) (y : Fin n.succ) :
    y = predAboveI i x ↔ i.succAbove y = x

entries.name: HepLean.Fin.predAboveI_lt
entries.snippet:
lemma predAboveI_lt {i x : Fin n.succ.succ} (h : x.val < i.val) :
    predAboveI i x = ⟨x.val, by omega⟩

entries.name: HepLean.Fin.predAboveI_ge
entries.snippet:
lemma predAboveI_ge {i x : Fin n.succ.succ} (h : i.val < x.val) :
    predAboveI i x = ⟨x.val - 1, by omega⟩

entries.name: HepLean.Fin.succAbove_succAbove_predAboveI
entries.snippet:
lemma succAbove_succAbove_predAboveI (i : Fin n.succ.succ) (j : Fin n.succ) (x : Fin n) :
    i.succAbove (j.succAbove x) =
    (i.succAbove j).succAbove ((predAboveI (i.succAbove j) i).succAbove x)

entries.name: HepLean.Fin.finExtractOne
entries.docstring:
The equivalence between `Fin n.succ` and `Fin 1 ⊕ Fin n` extracting the
  `i`th component.
entries.snippet: def finExtractOne {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n.succ) : Fin n.succ ≃ Fin 1 ⊕ Fin n

entries.name: HepLean.Fin.finExtractOne_apply_eq
entries.snippet:
lemma finExtractOne_apply_eq {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n.succ) :
    finExtractOne i i = Sum.inl 0

entries.name: HepLean.Fin.finExtractOne_symm_inr
entries.snippet:
lemma finExtractOne_symm_inr {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n.succ) :
    (finExtractOne i).symm ∘ Sum.inr = i.succAbove

entries.name: HepLean.Fin.finExtractOne_symm_inr_apply
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma finExtractOne_symm_inr_apply {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n.succ) (x : Fin n) :
    (finExtractOne i).symm (Sum.inr x) = i.succAbove x

entries.name: HepLean.Fin.finExtractOne_symm_inl_apply
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma finExtractOne_symm_inl_apply {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n.succ) :
    (finExtractOne i).symm (Sum.inl 0) = i

entries.name: HepLean.Fin.finExtractOnPermHom
entries.docstring:
Given an equivalence `Fin n.succ.succ ≃ Fin n.succ.succ`, and an `i : Fin n.succ.succ`,
  the map `Fin n.succ → Fin n.succ` obtained by dropping `i` and it's image.
entries.snippet:
def finExtractOnPermHom (i : Fin n.succ.succ) (σ : Fin n.succ.succ ≃ Fin n.succ.succ) :
    Fin n.succ → Fin n.succ

entries.name: HepLean.Fin.finExtractOnPermHom_inv
entries.snippet:
lemma finExtractOnPermHom_inv (i : Fin n.succ.succ) (σ : Fin n.succ.succ ≃ Fin n.succ.succ) :
    (finExtractOnPermHom (σ i) σ.symm) ∘ (finExtractOnPermHom i σ) = id

entries.name: HepLean.Fin.finExtractOnePerm
entries.docstring:
Given an equivalence `Fin n.succ.succ ≃ Fin n.succ.succ`, and an `i : Fin n.succ.succ`,
  the equivalence `Fin n.succ ≃ Fin n.succ` obtained by dropping `i` and it's image.
entries.snippet:
def finExtractOnePerm (i : Fin n.succ.succ) (σ : Fin n.succ.succ ≃ Fin n.succ.succ) :
    Fin n.succ ≃ Fin n.succ where

entries.name: HepLean.Fin.finExtractTwo
entries.docstring:
The equivalence of types `Fin n.succ.succ ≃ (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 1) ⊕ Fin n` extracting
  the `i` and `(i.succAbove j)`.
entries.snippet:
def finExtractTwo {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n.succ.succ) (j : Fin n.succ) :
    Fin n.succ.succ ≃ (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 1) ⊕ Fin n

entries.name: HepLean.Fin.finExtractTwo_apply_fst
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma finExtractTwo_apply_fst {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n.succ.succ) (j : Fin n.succ) :
    finExtractTwo i j i = Sum.inl (Sum.inl 0)

entries.name: HepLean.Fin.finExtractTwo_symm_inr
entries.snippet:
lemma finExtractTwo_symm_inr {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n.succ.succ) (j : Fin n.succ) :
    (finExtractTwo i j).symm ∘ Sum.inr = i.succAbove ∘ j.succAbove

entries.name: HepLean.Fin.finExtractTwo_symm_inr_apply
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma finExtractTwo_symm_inr_apply {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n.succ.succ) (j : Fin n.succ) (x : Fin n) :
    (finExtractTwo i j).symm (Sum.inr x) = i.succAbove (j.succAbove x)

entries.name: HepLean.Fin.finExtractTwo_symm_inl_inr_apply
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma finExtractTwo_symm_inl_inr_apply {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n.succ.succ) (j : Fin n.succ) :
    (finExtractTwo i j).symm (Sum.inl (Sum.inr 0)) = i.succAbove j

entries.name: HepLean.Fin.finExtractTwo_symm_inl_inl_apply
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma finExtractTwo_symm_inl_inl_apply {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n.succ.succ) (j : Fin n.succ) :
    (finExtractTwo i j).symm (Sum.inl (Sum.inl 0)) = i

entries.name: HepLean.Fin.finExtractTwo_apply_snd
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma finExtractTwo_apply_snd {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n.succ.succ) (j : Fin n.succ) :
    finExtractTwo i j (i.succAbove j) = Sum.inl (Sum.inr 0)

entries.name: HepLean.PiTensorProduct.induction_tmul

entries.snippet:
lemma induction_assoc
    {f g : ((⨂[R] i : ι1, s1 i) ⊗[R] (⨂[R] i : ι2, s2 i) ⊗[R] ⨂[R] i : ι3, s3 i) →ₗ[R] M}
    (h : ∀ p q m, f (PiTensorProduct.tprod R p ⊗ₜ[R]

    (h : ∀ p q m, f ((PiTensorProduct.tprod R p ⊗ₜ[R] PiTensorProduct.tprod R q) ⊗ₜ[R]

    ⊗ₜ[R] PiTensorProduct.tprod R m)) : f = g

entries.name: HepLean.PiTensorProduct.induction_tmul_mod

entries.name: HepLean.PiTensorProduct.induction_mod_tmul

entries.name: HepLean.PiTensorProduct.pureInl
entries.docstring: Takes a map `(i : ι1 ⊕ ι2) → Sum.elim s1 s2 i` to the underlying map `(i : ι1) → s1 i `.
entries.snippet: def pureInl (f : (i : ι1 ⊕ ι2) → Sum.elim s1 s2 i) : (i : ι1) → s1 i

entries.name: HepLean.PiTensorProduct.pureInr
entries.docstring: Takes a map `(i : ι1 ⊕ ι2) → Sum.elim s1 s2 i` to the underlying map `(i : ι2) → s2 i `.
entries.snippet: def pureInr (f : (i : ι1 ⊕ ι2) → Sum.elim s1 s2 i) : (i : ι2) → s2 i

entries.name: HepLean.PiTensorProduct.pureInl_update_left
entries.snippet:
lemma pureInl_update_left [DecidableEq ι1] (f : (i : ι1 ⊕ ι2) → Sum.elim s1 s2 i) (x : ι1)
    (v1 : s1 x) : pureInl (Function.update f (Sum.inl x) v1) =
    Function.update (pureInl f) x v1

entries.name: HepLean.PiTensorProduct.pureInr_update_left
entries.snippet:
lemma pureInr_update_left (f : (i : ι1 ⊕ ι2) → Sum.elim s1 s2 i) (x : ι1)
    (v2 : s1 x) :
    pureInr (Function.update f (Sum.inl x) v2) = (pureInr f)

entries.name: HepLean.PiTensorProduct.pureInr_update_right
entries.snippet:
lemma pureInr_update_right [DecidableEq ι2] (f : (i : ι1 ⊕ ι2) → Sum.elim s1 s2 i) (x : ι2)
    (v2 : s2 x) : pureInr (Function.update f (Sum.inr x) v2) =
    Function.update (pureInr f) x v2

entries.name: HepLean.PiTensorProduct.pureInl_update_right
entries.snippet:
lemma pureInl_update_right (f : (i : ι1 ⊕ ι2) → Sum.elim s1 s2 i) (x : ι2)
    (v1 : s2 x) :
    pureInl (Function.update f (Sum.inr x) v1) = (pureInl f)

def domCoprod :

entries.name: HepLean.PiTensorProduct.elimPureTensor
entries.docstring:
Produces a map `(i : ι1 ⊕ ι2) → Sum.elim s1 s2 i` from a map `(i : ι1) → s1 i` and a
  map `q : (i : ι2) → s2 i`.
entries.snippet: def elimPureTensor (p : (i : ι1) → s1 i) (q : (i : ι2) → s2 i) : (i : ι1 ⊕ ι2) → Sum.elim s1 s2 i

entries.name: HepLean.PiTensorProduct.elimPureTensor_update_right
entries.snippet:
lemma elimPureTensor_update_right (p : (i : ι1) → s1 i) (q : (i : ι2) → s2 i)
    (y : ι2) (r : s2 y) : elimPureTensor p (Function.update q y r) =
    Function.update (elimPureTensor p q) (Sum.inr y) r

entries.name: HepLean.PiTensorProduct.elimPureTensor_update_left
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma elimPureTensor_update_left (p : (i : ι1) → s1 i) (q : (i : ι2) → s2 i)
    (x : ι1) (r : s1 x) : elimPureTensor (Function.update p x r) q =
    Function.update (elimPureTensor p q) (Sum.inl x) r

The multilinear map valued in multilinear maps defined by combining

entries.snippet:
def elimPureTensorMulLin : MultilinearMap R s1

entries.name: HepLean.PiTensorProduct.tmulEquiv
entries.docstring: THe equivalence formed by combining a `TensorProduct` into a `PiTensorProduct`.
entries.snippet:
def tmulEquiv : ((⨂[R] i : ι1, s1 i) ⊗[R] ⨂[R] i : ι2, s2 i) ≃ₗ[R]

entries.name: HepLean.PiTensorProduct.tmulEquiv_tmul_tprod
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma tmulEquiv_tmul_tprod (p : (i : ι1) → s1 i) (q : (i : ι2) → s2 i) :
    tmulEquiv ((PiTensorProduct.tprod R) p ⊗ₜ[R] (PiTensorProduct.tprod R) q) =
    (PiTensorProduct.tprod R) (elimPureTensor p q)

entries.name: LorentzGroup.toComplex
entries.docstring: The monoid homomorphisms taking the lorentz group to complex matrices.
entries.snippet: def toComplex : LorentzGroup d →* Matrix (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) ℂ where

entries.name: LorentzGroup.«instance@d5fff600»
entries.snippet: instance (M : LorentzGroup d) : Invertible (toComplex M) where

entries.name: LorentzGroup.toComplex_inv
entries.snippet: lemma toComplex_inv (Λ : LorentzGroup d) : (toComplex Λ)⁻¹ = toComplex Λ⁻¹

entries.name: LorentzGroup.toComplex_mul_minkowskiMatrix_mul_transpose
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma toComplex_mul_minkowskiMatrix_mul_transpose (Λ : LorentzGroup d) :
    toComplex Λ * minkowskiMatrix.map ofReal * (toComplex Λ)ᵀ = minkowskiMatrix.map ofReal

entries.name: LorentzGroup.toComplex_transpose_mul_minkowskiMatrix_mul_self
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma toComplex_transpose_mul_minkowskiMatrix_mul_self (Λ : LorentzGroup d) :
    (toComplex Λ)ᵀ * minkowskiMatrix.map ofReal * toComplex Λ = minkowskiMatrix.map ofReal

entries.name: LorentzGroup.toComplex_mulVec_ofReal
entries.snippet:
lemma toComplex_mulVec_ofReal (v : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d → ℝ) (Λ : LorentzGroup d) :
    toComplex Λ *ᵥ (ofReal ∘ v) = ofReal ∘ (Λ *ᵥ v)

entries.name: SpaceTime.toSelfAdjointMatrix_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma toSelfAdjointMatrix_apply (x : LorentzVector 3) : toSelfAdjointMatrix x =
    x (Sum.inl 0) • ⟨PauliMatrix.σ0, PauliMatrix.σ0_selfAdjoint⟩
    - x (Sum.inr 0) • ⟨PauliMatrix.σ1, PauliMatrix.σ1_selfAdjoint⟩
    - x (Sum.inr 1) • ⟨PauliMatrix.σ2, PauliMatrix.σ2_selfAdjoint⟩
    - x (Sum.inr 2) • ⟨PauliMatrix.σ3, PauliMatrix.σ3_selfAdjoint⟩

entries.name: SpaceTime.toSelfAdjointMatrix_apply_coe
entries.snippet:
lemma toSelfAdjointMatrix_apply_coe (x : LorentzVector 3) : (toSelfAdjointMatrix x).1 =
    x (Sum.inl 0) • PauliMatrix.σ0
    - x (Sum.inr 0) • PauliMatrix.σ1
    - x (Sum.inr 1) • PauliMatrix.σ2
    - x (Sum.inr 2) • PauliMatrix.σ3

entries.name: SpaceTime.toSelfAdjointMatrix_stdBasis
entries.snippet:
lemma toSelfAdjointMatrix_stdBasis (i : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    toSelfAdjointMatrix (LorentzVector.stdBasis i) = PauliMatrix.σSAL i

entries.name: SpaceTime.toSelfAdjointMatrix_symm_basis
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma toSelfAdjointMatrix_symm_basis (i : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    toSelfAdjointMatrix.symm (PauliMatrix.σSAL i) = (LorentzVector.stdBasis i)

entries.name: Lorentz.complexContr

The representation of `SL(2, ℂ)` on complex vectors corresponding to contravariant

entries.snippet: def complexContr : Rep ℂ SL(2, ℂ)

entries.name: Lorentz.complexCo
entries.docstring:
The representation of `SL(2, ℂ)` on complex vectors corresponding to contravariant
  Lorentz vectors. In index notation these have a down index `ψⁱ`.
entries.snippet: def complexCo : Rep ℂ SL(2, ℂ)

entries.name: Lorentz.complexContrBasis
entries.docstring: The standard basis of complex contravariant Lorentz vectors.
entries.snippet: def complexContrBasis : Basis (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) ℂ complexContr

entries.name: Lorentz.complexContrBasis_toFin13ℂ
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma complexContrBasis_toFin13ℂ (i :Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    (complexContrBasis i).toFin13ℂ = Pi.single i 1

entries.name: Lorentz.complexContrBasis_ρ_apply
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma complexContrBasis_ρ_apply (M : SL(2,ℂ)) (i j : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    (LinearMap.toMatrix complexContrBasis complexContrBasis) (complexContr.ρ M) i j =
    (LorentzGroup.toComplex (SL2C.toLorentzGroup M)) i j

entries.name: Lorentz.complexContrBasis_ρ_val
entries.snippet:
lemma complexContrBasis_ρ_val (M : SL(2,ℂ)) (v : complexContr) :
    ((complexContr.ρ M) v).val =
    LorentzGroup.toComplex (SL2C.toLorentzGroup M) *ᵥ v.val

entries.name: Lorentz.complexContrBasisFin4
entries.docstring: The standard basis of complex contravariant Lorentz vectors indexed by `Fin 4`.
entries.snippet: def complexContrBasisFin4 : Basis (Fin 4) ℂ complexContr

entries.name: Lorentz.complexCoBasis

entries.snippet: def complexCoBasis : Basis (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) ℂ complexCo

entries.name: Lorentz.complexCoBasis_toFin13ℂ
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma complexCoBasis_toFin13ℂ (i :Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) : (complexCoBasis i).toFin13ℂ = Pi.single i 1

entries.name: Lorentz.complexCoBasis_ρ_apply
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma complexCoBasis_ρ_apply (M : SL(2,ℂ)) (i j : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    (LinearMap.toMatrix complexCoBasis complexCoBasis) (complexCo.ρ M) i j =
    (LorentzGroup.toComplex (SL2C.toLorentzGroup M))⁻¹ᵀ i j

entries.name: Lorentz.complexCoBasisFin4

entries.name: Lorentz.inclCongrRealLorentz
entries.docstring:
The semilinear map including real Lorentz vectors into complex contravariant
  lorentz vectors.
entries.snippet: def inclCongrRealLorentz : LorentzVector 3 →ₛₗ[Complex.ofReal] complexContr where

entries.name: Lorentz.inclCongrRealLorentz_val
entries.snippet:
lemma inclCongrRealLorentz_val (v : LorentzVector 3) :
    (inclCongrRealLorentz v).val = ofReal ∘ v

entries.name: Lorentz.complexContrBasis_of_real
entries.snippet:
lemma complexContrBasis_of_real (i : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    (complexContrBasis i) = inclCongrRealLorentz (LorentzVector.stdBasis i)

entries.name: Lorentz.inclCongrRealLorentz_ρ
entries.snippet:
lemma inclCongrRealLorentz_ρ (M : SL(2, ℂ)) (v : LorentzVector 3) :
    (complexContr.ρ M) (inclCongrRealLorentz v) =
    inclCongrRealLorentz (SL2C.repLorentzVector M v)

entries.name: Lorentz.SL2CRep_ρ_basis
entries.snippet:
lemma SL2CRep_ρ_basis (M : SL(2, ℂ)) (i : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    (complexContr.ρ M) (complexContrBasis i) =
    ∑ j, (SL2C.toLorentzGroup M).1 j i •
    complexContrBasis j

entries.name: Lorentz.contrCoContrBi
entries.docstring:

lemma asTensor_expand_complexContrBasis : asTensor =

    + complexContrBasis (Sum.inr 0) ⊗ₜ leftRightToMatrix.symm (σSA (Sum.inr 0))
    + complexContrBasis (Sum.inr 1) ⊗ₜ leftRightToMatrix.symm (σSA (Sum.inr 1))
    + complexContrBasis (Sum.inr 2) ⊗ₜ leftRightToMatrix.symm (σSA (Sum.inr 2))

entries.name: PauliMatrix.leftRightToMatrix_σSA_inl_0_expand
entries.docstring: The expansion of the pauli matrix `σ₀` in terms of a basis of tensor product vectors.
entries.snippet:
lemma leftRightToMatrix_σSA_inl_0_expand : leftRightToMatrix.symm (σSA (Sum.inl 0)) =
    leftBasis 0 ⊗ₜ rightBasis 0 + leftBasis 1 ⊗ₜ rightBasis 1

entries.name: PauliMatrix.leftRightToMatrix_σSA_inr_0_expand
entries.docstring: The expansion of the pauli matrix `σ₁` in terms of a basis of tensor product vectors.
entries.snippet:
lemma leftRightToMatrix_σSA_inr_0_expand : leftRightToMatrix.symm (σSA (Sum.inr 0)) =
    leftBasis 0 ⊗ₜ rightBasis 1 + leftBasis 1 ⊗ₜ rightBasis 0

entries.name: PauliMatrix.leftRightToMatrix_σSA_inr_1_expand
entries.docstring: The expansion of the pauli matrix `σ₂` in terms of a basis of tensor product vectors.
entries.snippet:
lemma leftRightToMatrix_σSA_inr_1_expand : leftRightToMatrix.symm (σSA (Sum.inr 1)) =
    -(I • leftBasis 0 ⊗ₜ[ℂ] rightBasis 1) + I • leftBasis 1 ⊗ₜ[ℂ] rightBasis 0

entries.name: PauliMatrix.leftRightToMatrix_σSA_inr_2_expand
entries.docstring: The expansion of the pauli matrix `σ₃` in terms of a basis of tensor product vectors.
entries.snippet:
lemma leftRightToMatrix_σSA_inr_2_expand : leftRightToMatrix.symm (σSA (Sum.inr 2)) =
    leftBasis 0 ⊗ₜ rightBasis 0 - leftBasis 1 ⊗ₜ rightBasis 1

entries.name: PauliMatrix.asTensor_expand
entries.docstring: The expansion of `asTensor` into complexContrBasis basis of tensor product vectors.
entries.snippet:
lemma asTensor_expand : asTensor =
    complexContrBasis (Sum.inl 0) ⊗ₜ (leftBasis 0 ⊗ₜ rightBasis 0)
    + complexContrBasis (Sum.inl 0) ⊗ₜ (leftBasis 1 ⊗ₜ rightBasis 1)
    + complexContrBasis (Sum.inr 0) ⊗ₜ (leftBasis 0 ⊗ₜ rightBasis 1)
    + complexContrBasis (Sum.inr 0) ⊗ₜ (leftBasis 1 ⊗ₜ rightBasis 0)
    - I • complexContrBasis (Sum.inr 1) ⊗ₜ (leftBasis 0 ⊗ₜ rightBasis 1)
    + I • complexContrBasis (Sum.inr 1) ⊗ₜ (leftBasis 1 ⊗ₜ rightBasis 0)
    + complexContrBasis (Sum.inr 2) ⊗ₜ (leftBasis 0 ⊗ₜ rightBasis 0)
    - complexContrBasis (Sum.inr 2) ⊗ₜ (leftBasis 1 ⊗ₜ rightBasis 1)

entries.name: PauliMatrix.σSAL
entries.docstring:
The basis of `selfAdjoint (Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)` formed by Pauli matrices
where the `1, 2, 3` pauli matrices are negated.

entries.name: PauliMatrix.σSAL_decomp
entries.snippet:
lemma σSAL_decomp (M : selfAdjoint (Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)) :
    M = (1/2 * (Matrix.trace (σ0 * M.1)).re) • σSAL (Sum.inl 0)
    + (-1/2 * (Matrix.trace (σ1 * M.1)).re) • σSAL (Sum.inr 0)
    + (-1/2 * (Matrix.trace (σ2 * M.1)).re) • σSAL (Sum.inr 1)
    + (-1/2 * (Matrix.trace (σ3 * M.1)).re) • σSAL (Sum.inr 2)

entries.name: Fermion.leftAltContraction
entries.docstring:
The linear map from leftHandedWeyl ⊗ altLeftHandedWeyl to ℂ given by
    summing over components of leftHandedWeyl and altLeftHandedWeyl in the
    standard basis (i.e. the dot product).
    Physically, the contraction of a left-handed Weyl fermion with a alt-left-handed Weyl fermion.
    In index notation this is ψ^a φ_a.
entries.snippet: def leftAltContraction : leftHanded ⊗ altLeftHanded ⟶ 𝟙_ (Rep ℂ SL(2,ℂ)) where

entries.name: Fermion.leftAltContraction_hom_tmul
entries.snippet:
lemma leftAltContraction_hom_tmul (ψ : leftHanded) (φ : altLeftHanded) :
    leftAltContraction.hom (ψ ⊗ₜ φ) = ψ.toFin2ℂ ⬝ᵥ φ.toFin2ℂ

entries.name: Fermion.leftAltContraction_basis
entries.snippet:
lemma leftAltContraction_basis (i j : Fin 2) :
    leftAltContraction.hom (leftBasis i ⊗ₜ altLeftBasis j) = if i.1 = j.1 then (1 : ℂ) else 0

entries.name: Fermion.altLeftContraction
entries.docstring:
The linear map from altLeftHandedWeyl ⊗ leftHandedWeyl to ℂ given by
    summing over components of altLeftHandedWeyl and leftHandedWeyl in the
    standard basis (i.e. the dot product).
    Physically, the contraction of a alt-left-handed Weyl fermion with a left-handed Weyl fermion.
    In index notation this is φ_a ψ^a.
entries.snippet: def altLeftContraction : altLeftHanded ⊗ leftHanded ⟶ 𝟙_ (Rep ℂ SL(2,ℂ)) where

entries.name: Fermion.altLeftContraction_hom_tmul
entries.snippet:
lemma altLeftContraction_hom_tmul (φ : altLeftHanded) (ψ : leftHanded) :
    altLeftContraction.hom (φ ⊗ₜ ψ) = φ.toFin2ℂ ⬝ᵥ ψ.toFin2ℂ

entries.name: Fermion.leftAltContraction_apply_metric
entries.snippet:
lemma leftAltContraction_apply_metric : (β_ leftHanded altLeftHanded).hom.hom
    ((leftHanded.V ◁ (λ_ altLeftHanded.V).hom)
    ((leftHanded.V ◁ leftAltContraction.hom ▷ altLeftHanded.V)
    ((leftHanded.V ◁ (α_ leftHanded.V altLeftHanded.V altLeftHanded.V).inv)
    ((α_ leftHanded.V leftHanded.V (altLeftHanded.V ⊗ altLeftHanded.V)).hom
    (leftMetric.hom (1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] altLeftMetric.hom (1 : ℂ)))))) =
    altLeftLeftUnit.hom (1 : ℂ)

entries.name: Fermion.altLeftContraction_apply_metric
entries.snippet:
lemma altLeftContraction_apply_metric : (β_ altLeftHanded leftHanded).hom.hom
    ((altLeftHanded.V ◁ (λ_ leftHanded.V).hom)
    ((altLeftHanded.V ◁ altLeftContraction.hom ▷ leftHanded.V)
    ((altLeftHanded.V ◁ (α_ altLeftHanded.V leftHanded.V leftHanded.V).inv)
    ((α_ altLeftHanded.V altLeftHanded.V (leftHanded.V ⊗ leftHanded.V)).hom

    ((rightHanded.V ◁ (α_ rightHanded.V altRightHanded.V altRightHanded.V).inv)
    ((α_ rightHanded.V rightHanded.V (altRightHanded.V ⊗ altRightHanded.V)).hom

entries.name: Fermion.altRightContraction_apply_metric

entries.snippet: def leftRightToMatrix : (leftHanded ⊗ rightHanded).V ≃ₗ[ℂ] Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ

entries.name: Fermion.leftRightToMatrix_symm_expand_tmul
entries.docstring: Expanding `leftRightToMatrix` in terms of the standard basis.
entries.snippet:
lemma leftRightToMatrix_symm_expand_tmul (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    leftRightToMatrix.symm M = ∑ i, ∑ j, M i j • (leftBasis i ⊗ₜ[ℂ] rightBasis j)

entries.name: Fermion.leftLeftToMatrix_ρ
entries.docstring:
The group action of `SL(2,ℂ)` on `leftHanded ⊗ leftHanded` is equivalent to
  `M.1 * leftLeftToMatrix v * (M.1)ᵀ`.
entries.snippet:
lemma leftLeftToMatrix_ρ (v : (leftHanded ⊗ leftHanded).V) (M : SL(2,ℂ)) :
    leftLeftToMatrix (TensorProduct.map (leftHanded.ρ M) (leftHanded.ρ M) v) =
    M.1 * leftLeftToMatrix v * (M.1)ᵀ

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsField.innerProd_expand'
entries.docstring:
Expands the inner product on Higgs fields in terms of complex components of the
  Higgs fields.
entries.snippet:
lemma innerProd_expand' (φ1 φ2 : HiggsField) (x : SpaceTime) :
    ⟪φ1, φ2⟫_H x = conj (φ1 x 0) * φ2 x 0 + conj (φ1 x 1) * φ2 x 1

entries.snippet:
lemma basis_contr (c : complexLorentzTensor.C) (i : Fin (complexLorentzTensor.repDim c))
    (j : Fin (complexLorentzTensor.repDim (complexLorentzTensor.τ c))) :
    complexLorentzTensor.castToField
    ((complexLorentzTensor.contr.app {as := c}).hom
    (complexLorentzTensor.basis c i ⊗ₜ complexLorentzTensor.basis (complexLorentzTensor.τ c) j)) =
    if i.val = j.val then 1 else 0

complexLorentzTensor.prodBasisVecEquiv
entries.docstring: Equivalence of Fin types appearing in the product of two basis vectors.
entries.snippet:
def prodBasisVecEquiv {n m : ℕ} {c : Fin n → complexLorentzTensor.C}
    {c1 : Fin m → complexLorentzTensor.C} (i : Fin n ⊕ Fin m) :
    Sum.elim (fun i => Fin (complexLorentzTensor.repDim (c i))) (fun i =>
      Fin (complexLorentzTensor.repDim (c1 i)))
    i ≃ Fin (complexLorentzTensor.repDim ((Sum.elim c c1 i)))

    (b : Π k, Fin (complexLorentzTensor.repDim (c k)))
    (b1 : Π k, Fin (complexLorentzTensor.repDim (c1 k))) :
    (prod (tensorNode (basisVector c b)) (tensorNode (basisVector c1 b1))).tensor =
    basisVector (Sum.elim c c1 ∘ finSumFinEquiv.symm) (fun i =>
    prodBasisVecEquiv (finSumFinEquiv.symm i)
    ((HepLean.PiTensorProduct.elimPureTensor b b1) (finSumFinEquiv.symm i)))

    (b1 : Π k, Fin (complexLorentzTensor.repDim (c1 k))) :

    (tensorNode (basisVector (Sum.elim c c1 ∘ finSumFinEquiv.symm) (fun i =>

entries.name: complexLorentzTensor.eval_basisVector
entries.snippet:
lemma eval_basisVector {n : ℕ} {c : Fin n.succ → complexLorentzTensor.C}
    {i : Fin n.succ} (j : Fin (complexLorentzTensor.repDim (c i)))
    (b : Π k, Fin (complexLorentzTensor.repDim (c k))) :
    (eval i j (tensorNode (basisVector c b))).tensor = (if j = b i then (1 : ℂ) else 0) •
    basisVector (c ∘ Fin.succAbove i) (fun k => b (i.succAbove k))

entries.name: complexLorentzTensor.basis_contr_pauliMatrix_basis_tree_expand_tensor
entries.snippet:
lemma basis_contr_pauliMatrix_basis_tree_expand_tensor {n : ℕ} {c : Fin n → complexLorentzTensor.C}
    (i : Fin (n + 3)) (j : Fin (n +2))
    (h : (pauliMatrixContrMap c) (i.succAbove j) = complexLorentzTensor.τ
      ((pauliMatrixContrMap c) i))
    (b : Π k, Fin (complexLorentzTensor.repDim (c k))) :
    (contr i j h (TensorTree.prod (tensorNode (basisVector c b))
    (tensorNode pauliContr))).tensor =
    (contrBasisVectorMul i j (pauliMatrixBasisProdMap b 0 0 0)) •
      (basisVectorContrPauli i j b 0 0 0)
    + (contrBasisVectorMul i j (pauliMatrixBasisProdMap b 0 1 1)) •
      (basisVectorContrPauli i j b 0 1 1)
    + (contrBasisVectorMul i j (pauliMatrixBasisProdMap b 1 0 1)) •
      (basisVectorContrPauli i j b 1 0 1)
    + (contrBasisVectorMul i j (pauliMatrixBasisProdMap b 1 1 0)) •
      (basisVectorContrPauli i j b 1 1 0)
    + (-I) • (contrBasisVectorMul i j (pauliMatrixBasisProdMap b 2 0 1)) •
      (basisVectorContrPauli i j b 2 0 1)
    + I • (contrBasisVectorMul i j (pauliMatrixBasisProdMap b 2 1 0)) •
      (basisVectorContrPauli i j b 2 1 0)
    + (contrBasisVectorMul i j (pauliMatrixBasisProdMap b 3 0 0)) •
      (basisVectorContrPauli i j b 3 0 0)
    + (-1 : ℂ) • (contrBasisVectorMul i j (pauliMatrixBasisProdMap b 3 1 1)) •
      (basisVectorContrPauli i j b 3 1 1)

entries.name: IndexNotation.OverColor.Discrete.pair
entries.docstring: The functor taking `c` to `F c ⊗ F c`.
entries.snippet: def pair : Discrete C ⥤ Rep k G

entries.name: IndexNotation.OverColor.Discrete.pairIso
entries.docstring:
The isomorphism between the image of `(pair F).obj` and
  `(lift.obj F).obj (OverColor.mk ![c,c])`.
entries.snippet: def pairIso (c : C) : (pair F).obj (Discrete.mk c) ≅ (lift.obj F).obj (OverColor.mk ![c,c])

entries.name: IndexNotation.OverColor.Discrete.pairIsoSep
entries.docstring:
The isomorphism between `F.obj (Discrete.mk c1) ⊗ F.obj (Discrete.mk c2)` and
  `(lift.obj F).obj (OverColor.mk ![c1,c2])` formed by the tensorate.
entries.snippet:
def pairIsoSep {c1 c2 : C} : F.obj (Discrete.mk c1) ⊗ F.obj (Discrete.mk c2) ≅
    (lift.obj F).obj (OverColor.mk ![c1,c2])

entries.name: IndexNotation.OverColor.Discrete.pairIsoSep_tmul
entries.snippet:
lemma pairIsoSep_tmul {c1 c2 : C} (x : F.obj (Discrete.mk c1)) (y : F.obj (Discrete.mk c2)) :
    (pairIsoSep F).hom.hom (x ⊗ₜ[k] y) =
    PiTensorProduct.tprod k (Fin.cases x (Fin.cases y (fun i => Fin.elim0 i)))

entries.name: IndexNotation.OverColor.Discrete.tripleIsoSep
entries.docstring:
The isomorphism between
  `F.obj (Discrete.mk c1) ⊗ F.obj (Discrete.mk c2) ⊗ F.obj (Discrete.mk c3)` and
  `(lift.obj F).obj (OverColor.mk ![c1,c2])` formed by the tensorate.

entries.name: IndexNotation.OverColor.Discrete.tripleIsoSep_tmul
entries.snippet:
lemma tripleIsoSep_tmul {c1 c2 c3 : C} (x : F.obj (Discrete.mk c1)) (y : F.obj (Discrete.mk c2))
    (z : F.obj (Discrete.mk c3)) :
    (tripleIsoSep F).hom.hom (x ⊗ₜ[k] y ⊗ₜ[k] z) = PiTensorProduct.tprod k
      (fun | (0 : Fin 3) => x | (1 : Fin 3) => y | (2 : Fin 3) => z)

entries.name: IndexNotation.OverColor.Discrete.pairτ

entries.snippet: def pairτ (τ : C → C) : Discrete C ⥤ Rep k G

entries.name: IndexNotation.OverColor.Discrete.pairτ_tmul
entries.snippet:
lemma pairτ_tmul {c : C} (x : F.obj (Discrete.mk c))
    (y : ↑(((Action.functorCategoryEquivalence (ModuleCat k) (MonCat.of G)).symm.inverse.obj
    ((Discrete.functor (Discrete.mk ∘ τ) ⋙ F).obj { as := c })).obj PUnit.unit)) (h : c = c1) :
    ((pairτ F τ).map (Discrete.eqToHom h)).hom (x ⊗ₜ[k] y)= ((F.map (Discrete.eqToHom h)).hom x)
    ⊗ₜ[k] ((F.map (Discrete.eqToHom (by simp [h]))).hom y)

entries.name: IndexNotation.OverColor.equivToIso
entries.docstring:
The isomorphism between `c : X → C` and `c ∘ e.symm` as objects in `OverColor C` for an

entries.snippet: def equivToIso {c : X → C} (e : X ≃ Y) : mk c ≅ mk (c ∘ e.symm)

entries.name: IndexNotation.OverColor.equivToIso_homToEquiv
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma equivToIso_homToEquiv {c : X → C} (e : X ≃ Y) :
    Hom.toEquiv (equivToIso (c := c) e).hom = e

entries.snippet: def mkSum (c : X ⊕ Y → C) : mk c ≅ mk (c ∘ Sum.inl) ⊗ mk (c ∘ Sum.inr)

@[simp]

@[simp]

entries.name: IndexNotation.OverColor.mkIso
entries.docstring: The isomorphism between objects in `OverColor C` given equality of maps.
entries.snippet: def mkIso {c1 c2 : X → C} (h : c1 = c2) : mk c1 ≅ mk c2

entries.name: IndexNotation.OverColor.mkIso_refl_hom
entries.snippet: lemma mkIso_refl_hom {c : X → C} : (mkIso (by rfl : c =c)).hom = 𝟙 _

entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma equivToIso_mkIso_hom {c1 c2 : X → C} (h : c1 = c2) :

entries.name: IndexNotation.OverColor.equivToHomEq
entries.docstring:
The homorophism from `mk c` to `mk c1` obtaied by an equivalence and
  an equality lemma.
entries.snippet:
def equivToHomEq {c : X → C} {c1 : Y → C} (e : X ≃ Y)
    (h : ∀ x, c1 x = (c ∘ e.symm) x := by decide) : mk c ⟶ mk c1

entries.name: IndexNotation.OverColor.fin2Iso
entries.docstring:
The isomorphism splitting a `mk c` for `Fin 2 → C` into the tensor product of
  the `Fin 1 → C` maps defined by `c 0` and `c 1`.
entries.snippet: def fin2Iso {c : Fin 2 → C} : mk c ≅ mk ![c 0] ⊗ mk ![c 1]

entries.name: IndexNotation.OverColor.fin3Iso
entries.docstring:
The isomorphism splitting a `mk c` for `c : Fin 3 → C` into the tensor product of
  a `Fin 1 → C` map `![c 0]` and a `Fin 2 → C` map `![c 1, c 2]`.
entries.snippet: def fin3Iso {c : Fin 3 → C} : mk c ≅ mk ![c 0] ⊗ mk ![c 1, c 2]

entries.name: IndexNotation.OverColor.fin3Iso'
entries.docstring:
The isomorphism splitting a `mk ![c1, c2, c3]` into the tensor product of
  a `Fin 1 → C` map `fun _ => c1` and a `Fin 2 → C` map `![c 1, c 2]`.
entries.snippet: def fin3Iso' {c1 c2 c3 : C} : mk ![c1, c2, c3] ≅ mk (fun (_ : Fin 1) => c1) ⊗ mk ![c2, c3]

entries.name: IndexNotation.OverColor.extractOne
entries.docstring: Removes a given `i : Fin n.succ.succ` from a morphism in `OverColor C`.

entries.name: IndexNotation.OverColor.extractOne_homToEquiv
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma extractOne_homToEquiv {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n.succ.succ)
    {c1 c2 : Fin n.succ.succ → C} (σ : mk c1 ⟶ mk c2) : Hom.toEquiv (extractOne i σ) =
    (finExtractOnePerm ((Hom.toEquiv σ).symm i) (Hom.toEquiv σ))

entries.name: IndexNotation.OverColor.extractTwo
entries.docstring: Removes a given `i : Fin n.succ.succ` and `j : Fin n.succ` from a morphism in `OverColor C`.
entries.snippet:
def extractTwo {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n.succ.succ) (j : Fin n.succ)
    {c1 c2 : Fin n.succ.succ → C} (σ : mk c1 ⟶ mk c2) :
    mk (c1 ∘ Fin.succAbove ((Hom.toEquiv σ).symm i) ∘
      Fin.succAbove (((Hom.toEquiv (extractOne i σ))).symm j)) ⟶
    mk (c2 ∘ Fin.succAbove i ∘ Fin.succAbove j)

entries.name: IndexNotation.OverColor.extractTwoAux
entries.docstring:
Removes a given `i : Fin n.succ.succ` and `j : Fin n.succ` from a morphism in `OverColor C`.
  This is from and to different (by equivalent) objects to `extractTwo`.
entries.snippet:
def extractTwoAux {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n.succ.succ) (j : Fin n.succ)
    {c c1 : Fin n.succ.succ → C} (σ : mk c ⟶ mk c1) :
    mk ((c ∘ ⇑(finExtractTwo ((Hom.toEquiv σ).symm i)
    ((Hom.toEquiv (extractOne i σ)).symm j)).symm) ∘ Sum.inr) ⟶
    mk ((c1 ∘ ⇑(finExtractTwo i j).symm) ∘ Sum.inr)

entries.name: IndexNotation.OverColor.extractTwoAux'
entries.docstring:
Given a morphism ` mk c ⟶ mk c1` the corresponding morphism on the `Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 1` maps
  obtained by extracting `i` and `j`.
entries.snippet:
def extractTwoAux' {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n.succ.succ) (j : Fin n.succ)
    {c c1 : Fin n.succ.succ → C} (σ : mk c ⟶ mk c1) :
  mk ((c ∘ ⇑(finExtractTwo ((Hom.toEquiv σ).symm i)
  ((Hom.toEquiv (extractOne i σ)).symm j)).symm) ∘ Sum.inl) ⟶
  mk ((c1 ∘ ⇑(finExtractTwo i j).symm) ∘ Sum.inl)

entries.name: IndexNotation.OverColor.extractTwo_finExtractTwo_succ
entries.snippet:
lemma extractTwo_finExtractTwo_succ {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n.succ.succ.succ) (j : Fin n.succ.succ)
    {c c1 : Fin n.succ.succ.succ → C} (σ : mk c ⟶ mk c1) :
    σ ≫ (equivToIso (HepLean.Fin.finExtractTwo i j)).hom ≫
    (mkSum (c1 ∘ ⇑(HepLean.Fin.finExtractTwo i j).symm)).hom =
    (equivToIso (HepLean.Fin.finExtractTwo ((Hom.toEquiv σ).symm i)
    (((Hom.toEquiv (extractOne i σ))).symm j))).hom
    ≫ (mkSum (c ∘ ⇑(HepLean.Fin.finExtractTwo ((Hom.toEquiv σ).symm i)
    (((Hom.toEquiv (extractOne i σ))).symm j)).symm)).hom
    ≫ ((extractTwoAux' i j σ) ⊗ (extractTwoAux i j σ))

entries.name: IndexNotation.OverColor.extractTwo_finExtractTwo
entries.snippet:
lemma extractTwo_finExtractTwo {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n.succ.succ) (j : Fin n.succ)
    {c c1 : Fin n.succ.succ → C} (σ : mk c ⟶ mk c1) :
    σ ≫ (equivToIso (HepLean.Fin.finExtractTwo i j)).hom ≫
    (mkSum (c1 ∘ ⇑(HepLean.Fin.finExtractTwo i j).symm)).hom =
    (equivToIso (HepLean.Fin.finExtractTwo ((Hom.toEquiv σ).symm i)
    (((Hom.toEquiv (extractOne i σ))).symm j))).hom
    ≫ (mkSum (c ∘ ⇑(HepLean.Fin.finExtractTwo ((Hom.toEquiv σ).symm i)
    (((Hom.toEquiv (extractOne i σ))).symm j)).symm)).hom
    ≫ ((extractTwoAux' i j σ) ⊗ (extractTwoAux i j σ))

entries.name: IndexNotation.OverColor.contrPairFin1Fin1
entries.docstring:
The isomorphism between a `Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 1 → C` satisfying the condition
  `c (Sum.inr 0) = τ (c (Sum.inl 0))`
  and an object in the image of `contrPair`.

entries.name: IndexNotation.OverColor.contrPairEquiv
entries.docstring:
The Isomorphism between a `Fin n.succ.succ → C` and the product containing an object in the
  image of `contrPair` based on the given values.
entries.snippet:
def contrPairEquiv {n : ℕ} (τ : C → C) (c : Fin n.succ.succ → C) (i : Fin n.succ.succ)
    (j : Fin n.succ) (h : c (i.succAbove j) = τ (c i)) :
    OverColor.mk c ≅ ((contrPair C τ).obj (Over.mk (fun (_ : Fin 1) => c i))) ⊗
    (OverColor.mk (c ∘ i.succAbove ∘ j.succAbove))

entries.name: IndexNotation.OverColor.lift.discreteFunctorMapIso
entries.docstring: Takes a homorphisms of `Discrete C` to an isomorphism `F.obj c1 ≅ F.obj c2`.
entries.snippet:
def discreteFunctorMapIso {c1 c2 : Discrete C} (h : c1 ⟶ c2) :
    F.obj c1 ≅ F.obj c2

entries.name: IndexNotation.OverColor.lift.discreteFun_hom_trans
entries.snippet:
lemma discreteFun_hom_trans {c1 c2 c3 : Discrete C} (h1 : c1 = c2) (h2 : c2 = c3)
    (v : F.obj c1) : (F.map (eqToHom h2)).hom ((F.map (eqToHom h1)).hom v)
    = (F.map (eqToHom (h1.trans h2))).hom v

entries.name: IndexNotation.OverColor.lift.discreteFunctorMapEqIso
entries.docstring:
The linear equivalence between `(F.obj c1).V ≃ₗ[k] (F.obj c2).V` induced by an equality of
  `c1` and `c2`.
entries.snippet:
def discreteFunctorMapEqIso {c1 c2 : Discrete C} (h : c1.as = c2.as) :
    (F.obj c1).V ≃ₗ[k] (F.obj c2).V

entries.name: IndexNotation.OverColor.lift.discreteFunctorMapEqIso_comm_ρ
entries.snippet:
lemma discreteFunctorMapEqIso_comm_ρ {c1 c2 : Discrete C} (h : c1.as = c2.as) (M : G)
    (x : F.obj c1) : discreteFunctorMapEqIso F h ((F.obj c1).ρ M x) =
    (F.obj c2).ρ M (discreteFunctorMapEqIso F h x)

entries.name: IndexNotation.OverColor.lift.objObj'
entries.docstring: Given a object in `OverColor Color` the correpsonding tensor product of representations.

entries.name: IndexNotation.OverColor.lift.objObj'_ρ
entries.snippet:
lemma objObj'_ρ (f : OverColor C) (M : G) : (objObj' F f).ρ M =

entries.name: IndexNotation.OverColor.lift.objObj'_ρ_tprod
entries.snippet:
lemma objObj'_ρ_tprod (f : OverColor C) (M : G) (x : (i : f.left) → F.obj (Discrete.mk (f.hom i))) :
    (objObj' F f).ρ M (PiTensorProduct.tprod k x) =
    PiTensorProduct.tprod k fun i => (F.obj (Discrete.mk (f.hom i))).ρ M (x i)

entries.name: IndexNotation.OverColor.lift.objObj'_ρ_empty
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma objObj'_ρ_empty (g : G) : (objObj' F (𝟙_ (OverColor C))).ρ g = LinearMap.id

entries.name: IndexNotation.OverColor.lift.objObj'_V_carrier
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma objObj'_V_carrier (f : OverColor C) :
    (objObj' F f).V = ⨂[k] (i : f.left), F.obj (Discrete.mk (f.hom i))

entries.name: IndexNotation.OverColor.lift.mapToLinearEquiv'
entries.docstring:
Given a morphism in `OverColor C` the corresopnding linear equivalence between `obj' _`
  induced by reindexing.
entries.snippet: def mapToLinearEquiv' {f g : OverColor C} (m : f ⟶ g) : (objObj' F f).V ≃ₗ[k] (objObj' F g).V

entries.name: IndexNotation.OverColor.lift.mapToLinearEquiv'_tprod
entries.snippet:
lemma mapToLinearEquiv'_tprod {f g : OverColor C} (m : f ⟶ g)
    (x : (i : f.left) → (F.obj (Discrete.mk (f.hom i)))) :
    mapToLinearEquiv' F m (PiTensorProduct.tprod k x) =
    PiTensorProduct.tprod k (fun i => (discreteFunctorMapEqIso F (Hom.toEquiv_symm_apply m i))
    (x ((OverColor.Hom.toEquiv m).symm i)))

entries.name: IndexNotation.OverColor.lift.objMap'
entries.docstring:
Given a morphism in `OverColor C` the corresopnding map of representations induced by
  reindexing.
entries.snippet: def objMap' {f g : OverColor C} (m : f ⟶ g) : objObj' F f ⟶ objObj' F g where

entries.name: IndexNotation.OverColor.lift.objMap'_tprod
entries.snippet:
lemma objMap'_tprod {X Y : OverColor C} (p : (i : X.left) → F.obj (Discrete.mk (X.hom i)))
    (f : X ⟶ Y) : (objMap' F f).hom (PiTensorProduct.tprod k p) =
    PiTensorProduct.tprod k fun (i : Y.left) => discreteFunctorMapEqIso F
    (OverColor.Hom.toEquiv_comp_inv_apply f i) (p ((OverColor.Hom.toEquiv f).symm i))

entries.name: IndexNotation.OverColor.lift.ε
entries.docstring: The unit natural isomorphism.
entries.snippet: def ε : 𝟙_ (Rep k G) ≅ objObj' F (𝟙_ (OverColor C))

entries.name: IndexNotation.OverColor.lift.discreteSumEquiv
entries.docstring: An auxillary equivalence, and trivial, of modules needed to define `μModEquiv`.

entries.name: IndexNotation.OverColor.lift.discreteSumEquiv'
entries.docstring:
An equivalence used in the lemma of `μ_tmul_tprod_mk`. Identical to `μModEquiv`
  except with arguments based on maps instead of elements of `OverColor C`.

entries.name: IndexNotation.OverColor.lift.μModEquiv
entries.docstring: The equivalence of modules corresonding to the tensorate.
entries.snippet:
def μModEquiv (X Y : OverColor C) :
    (objObj' F X ⊗ objObj' F Y).V ≃ₗ[k] objObj' F (X ⊗ Y)

entries.name: IndexNotation.OverColor.lift.μModEquiv_tmul_tprod
entries.snippet:
lemma μModEquiv_tmul_tprod {X Y : OverColor C}
    (p : (i : X.left) → F.obj (Discrete.mk (X.hom i)))
    (q : (i : Y.left) → F.obj (Discrete.mk (Y.hom i))) :
    μModEquiv F X Y (PiTensorProduct.tprod k p ⊗ₜ[k] PiTensorProduct.tprod k q) =
    PiTensorProduct.tprod k fun i =>
    (discreteSumEquiv F i) (HepLean.PiTensorProduct.elimPureTensor p q i)

entries.name: IndexNotation.OverColor.lift.μ
entries.docstring: The natural isomorphism corresponding to the tensorate.
entries.snippet: def μ (X Y : OverColor C) : objObj' F X ⊗ objObj' F Y ≅ objObj' F (X ⊗ Y)

entries.name: IndexNotation.OverColor.lift.μ_tmul_tprod
entries.snippet:
lemma μ_tmul_tprod {X Y : OverColor C} (p : (i : X.left) → F.obj (Discrete.mk <| X.hom i))
    (q : (i : Y.left) → (F.obj <| Discrete.mk (Y.hom i))) :
    (μ F X Y).hom.hom (PiTensorProduct.tprod k p ⊗ₜ[k] PiTensorProduct.tprod k q) =
    (PiTensorProduct.tprod k) fun i =>
    discreteSumEquiv F i (HepLean.PiTensorProduct.elimPureTensor p q i)

entries.name: IndexNotation.OverColor.lift.μ_tmul_tprod_mk
entries.snippet:
lemma μ_tmul_tprod_mk {X Y : Type} {cX : X → C} {cY : Y → C}
    (p : (i : X) → F.obj (Discrete.mk <| cX i))
    (q : (i : Y) → (F.obj <| Discrete.mk (cY i))) :
    (μ F (OverColor.mk cX) (OverColor.mk cY)).hom.hom
    (PiTensorProduct.tprod k p ⊗ₜ[k] PiTensorProduct.tprod k q)
    = (PiTensorProduct.tprod k) fun i =>
    discreteSumEquiv' F i (HepLean.PiTensorProduct.elimPureTensor p q i)

entries.name: IndexNotation.OverColor.lift.μ_natural_left
entries.snippet:
lemma μ_natural_left {X Y : OverColor C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (Z : OverColor C) :
    MonoidalCategory.whiskerRight (objMap' F f) (objObj' F Z) ≫ (μ F Y Z).hom =
    (μ F X Z).hom ≫ objMap' F (MonoidalCategory.whiskerRight f Z)

entries.name: IndexNotation.OverColor.lift.μ_natural_right
entries.snippet:
lemma μ_natural_right {X Y : OverColor C} (X' : OverColor C) (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    MonoidalCategory.whiskerLeft (objObj' F X') (objMap' F f) ≫ (μ F X' Y).hom =
    (μ F X' X).hom ≫ objMap' F (MonoidalCategory.whiskerLeft X' f)

entries.name: IndexNotation.OverColor.lift.associativity
entries.snippet:
lemma associativity (X Y Z : OverColor C) :
    whiskerRight (μ F X Y).hom (objObj' F Z) ≫
    (μ F (X ⊗ Y) Z).hom ≫ objMap' F (associator X Y Z).hom =
    (associator (objObj' F X) (objObj' F Y) (objObj' F Z)).hom ≫
    whiskerLeft (objObj' F X) (μ F Y Z).hom ≫ (μ F X (Y ⊗ Z)).hom

entries.name: IndexNotation.OverColor.lift.left_unitality
entries.snippet:
lemma left_unitality (X : OverColor C) : (leftUnitor (objObj' F X)).hom =
    whiskerRight (ε F).hom (objObj' F X) ≫
    (μ F (𝟙_ (OverColor C)) X).hom ≫ objMap' F (leftUnitor X).hom

entries.name: IndexNotation.OverColor.lift.right_unitality
entries.snippet:
lemma right_unitality (X : OverColor C) : (rightUnitor (objObj' F X)).hom =
    whiskerLeft (objObj' F X) (ε F).hom ≫
    (μ F X (𝟙_ (OverColor C))).hom ≫ objMap' F (rightUnitor X).hom

entries.name: IndexNotation.OverColor.lift.braided'
entries.snippet:
lemma braided' (X Y : OverColor C) : (μ F X Y).hom ≫ (objMap' F) (β_ X Y).hom =
    (β_ (objObj' F X) (objObj' F Y)).hom ≫ (μ F Y X).hom

entries.name: IndexNotation.OverColor.lift.braided
entries.snippet:
lemma braided (X Y : OverColor C) :
    (objMap' F) (β_ X Y).hom = (μ F X Y).inv ≫
    ((β_ (objObj' F X) (objObj' F Y)).hom ≫ (μ F Y X).hom)

entries.name: IndexNotation.OverColor.lift.objMap'_id
entries.snippet: lemma objMap'_id (X : OverColor C) : objMap' F (𝟙 X) = 𝟙 _

entries.name: IndexNotation.OverColor.lift.objMap'_comp
entries.snippet:
lemma objMap'_comp {X Y Z : OverColor C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) :
    objMap' F (f ≫ g) = objMap' F f ≫ objMap' F g

entries.name: IndexNotation.OverColor.lift.obj'
entries.docstring: The `BraidedFunctor (OverColor C) (Rep k G)` from a functor `Discrete C ⥤ Rep k G`.
entries.snippet: def obj' : BraidedFunctor (OverColor C) (Rep k G) where

entries.name: IndexNotation.OverColor.lift.mapApp'
entries.docstring: The maps for a natural transformation between `obj' F` and `obj' F'`.

entries.name: IndexNotation.OverColor.lift.mapApp'_tprod
entries.snippet:
lemma mapApp'_tprod (X : OverColor C) (p : (i : X.left) → F.obj (Discrete.mk (X.hom i))) :
    (mapApp' η X).hom (PiTensorProduct.tprod k p) =

entries.name: IndexNotation.OverColor.lift.mapApp'_naturality
entries.snippet:
lemma mapApp'_naturality {X Y : OverColor C} (f : X ⟶ Y) :

entries.name: IndexNotation.OverColor.lift.mapApp'_unit
entries.snippet: lemma mapApp'_unit : (obj' F).ε ≫ mapApp' η (𝟙_ (OverColor C)) = (obj' F').ε

entries.name: IndexNotation.OverColor.lift.mapApp'_tensor
entries.snippet:
lemma mapApp'_tensor (X Y : OverColor C) :
    (obj' F).μ X Y ≫ mapApp' η (X ⊗ Y) =
    (mapApp' η X ⊗ mapApp' η Y) ≫ (obj' F').μ X Y

entries.docstring:
Given a natural transformation between `F F' : Discrete C ⥤ Rep k G` the

entries.snippet: def map' : obj' F ⟶ obj' F' where

entries.name: IndexNotation.OverColor.lift
entries.docstring:
The functor taking functors in `Discrete C ⥤ Rep k G` to monoidal functors in
  `BraidedFunctor (OverColor C) (Rep k G)`, built on the PiTensorProduct.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def lift : (Discrete C ⥤ Rep k G) ⥤ BraidedFunctor (OverColor C) (Rep k G) where

entries.name: IndexNotation.OverColor.lift.map_tprod
entries.snippet:
lemma map_tprod (F : Discrete C ⥤ Rep k G) {X Y : OverColor C} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (p : (i : X.left) → F.obj (Discrete.mk <| X.hom i)) :
    ((lift.obj F).map f).hom (PiTensorProduct.tprod k p) =
    PiTensorProduct.tprod k fun (i : Y.left) => discreteFunctorMapEqIso F
    (OverColor.Hom.toEquiv_comp_inv_apply f i) (p ((OverColor.Hom.toEquiv f).symm i))

entries.name: IndexNotation.OverColor.lift.obj_μ_tprod_tmul
entries.snippet:
lemma obj_μ_tprod_tmul (F : Discrete C ⥤ Rep k G) (X Y : OverColor C)
    (p : (i : X.left) → (F.obj (Discrete.mk <| X.hom i)))
    (q : (i : Y.left) → F.obj (Discrete.mk <| Y.hom i)) :
    ((lift.obj F).μ X Y).hom (PiTensorProduct.tprod k p ⊗ₜ[k] PiTensorProduct.tprod k q) =
    (PiTensorProduct.tprod k) fun i =>
    discreteSumEquiv F i (HepLean.PiTensorProduct.elimPureTensor p q i)

entries.name: IndexNotation.OverColor.lift.μIso_inv_tprod
entries.snippet:
lemma μIso_inv_tprod (F : Discrete C ⥤ Rep k G) (X Y : OverColor C)
    (p : (i : (X ⊗ Y).left) → F.obj (Discrete.mk <| (X ⊗ Y).hom i)) :
    ((lift.obj F).μIso X Y).inv.hom (PiTensorProduct.tprod k p) =
    (PiTensorProduct.tprod k (fun i => p (Sum.inl i))) ⊗ₜ[k]
    (PiTensorProduct.tprod k (fun i => p (Sum.inr i)))

lemma inv_μ (X Y : OverColor C) : inv ((lift.obj F).μ X Y) =

entries.name: IndexNotation.OverColor.forgetLiftAppV
entries.docstring:

lemma forgetLiftAppV_symm_apply (c : C) (x : (F.obj (Discrete.mk c)).V) :

entries.name: IndexNotation.OverColor.forgetLiftApp
entries.docstring:

entries.name: IndexNotation.OverColor.forgetLiftApp_hom_hom_apply_eq

lemma forgetLiftApp_hom_hom_apply_eq (c : C)
    (x : (lift.obj F).obj (OverColor.mk (fun (_ : Fin 1) => c)))
    (y : (F.obj (Discrete.mk c)).V) :

informal_definition forgetLift where

entries.name: TensorSpecies
entries.docstring:
The sturcture of a type of tensors e.g. Lorentz tensors, Einstien tensors,
  complex Lorentz tensors.
entries.snippet:
structure TensorSpecies where
  C : Type
  G : Type
  G_group : Group G
  k : Type
  k_commRing : CommRing k
  FDiscrete : Discrete C ⥤ Rep k G
  τ : C → C
  τ_involution : Function.Involutive τ
  contr : OverColor.Discrete.pairτ FDiscrete τ ⟶ 𝟙_ (Discrete C ⥤ Rep k G)
  metric : 𝟙_ (Discrete C ⥤ Rep k G) ⟶ OverColor.Discrete.pair FDiscrete
  unit : 𝟙_ (Discrete C ⥤ Rep k G) ⟶ OverColor.Discrete.τPair FDiscrete τ
  repDim : C → ℕ
  repDim_neZero (c : C) : NeZero (repDim c)
  basis : (c : C) → Basis (Fin (repDim c)) k (FDiscrete.obj (Discrete.mk c)).V
  contr_tmul_symm (c : C) (x : FDiscrete.obj (Discrete.mk c))
      (y : FDiscrete.obj (Discrete.mk (τ c))) :
    (contr.app (Discrete.mk c)).hom (x ⊗ₜ[k] y) = (contr.app (Discrete.mk (τ c))).hom
      (y ⊗ₜ (FDiscrete.map (Discrete.eqToHom (τ_involution c).symm)).hom x)
  contr_unit (c : C) (x : FDiscrete.obj (Discrete.mk (c))) :
    (λ_ (FDiscrete.obj (Discrete.mk (c)))).hom.hom
    (((contr.app (Discrete.mk c)) ▷ (FDiscrete.obj (Discrete.mk (c)))).hom
    ((α_ _ _ (FDiscrete.obj (Discrete.mk (c)))).inv.hom
    (x ⊗ₜ[k] (unit.app (Discrete.mk c)).hom (1 : k)))) = x
  unit_symm (c : C) :
    ((unit.app (Discrete.mk c)).hom (1 : k)) =
    ((FDiscrete.obj (Discrete.mk (τ (c)))) ◁
      (FDiscrete.map (Discrete.eqToHom (τ_involution c)))).hom
    ((β_ (FDiscrete.obj (Discrete.mk (τ (τ c)))) (FDiscrete.obj (Discrete.mk (τ (c))))).hom.hom
    ((unit.app (Discrete.mk (τ c))).hom (1 : k)))
  contr_metric (c : C) :
    (β_ (FDiscrete.obj (Discrete.mk c)) (FDiscrete.obj (Discrete.mk (τ c)))).hom.hom
    (((FDiscrete.obj (Discrete.mk c)) ◁ (λ_ (FDiscrete.obj (Discrete.mk (τ c)))).hom).hom
    (((FDiscrete.obj (Discrete.mk c)) ◁ ((contr.app (Discrete.mk c)) ▷
    (FDiscrete.obj (Discrete.mk (τ c))))).hom
    (((FDiscrete.obj (Discrete.mk c)) ◁ (α_ (FDiscrete.obj (Discrete.mk (c)))
      (FDiscrete.obj (Discrete.mk (τ c))) (FDiscrete.obj (Discrete.mk (τ c)))).inv).hom
    ((α_ (FDiscrete.obj (Discrete.mk (c))) (FDiscrete.obj (Discrete.mk (c)))
      (FDiscrete.obj (Discrete.mk (τ c)) ⊗ FDiscrete.obj (Discrete.mk (τ c)))).hom.hom
    ((metric.app (Discrete.mk c)).hom (1 : k) ⊗ₜ[k]

TensorSpecies.contrFin1Fin1
entries.docstring:
The isomorphism between the image of a map `Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 1 → S.C` contructed by `finExtractTwo`
  under `S.F.obj`, and an object in the image of `OverColor.Discrete.pairτ S.FDiscrete`.

entries.name: TensorSpecies.contrFin1Fin1_inv_tmul
entries.snippet:
lemma contrFin1Fin1_inv_tmul {n : ℕ} (c : Fin n.succ.succ → S.C)
    (i : Fin n.succ.succ) (j : Fin n.succ) (h : c (i.succAbove j) = S.τ (c i))
    (x : S.FDiscrete.obj { as := c i })
    (y : S.FDiscrete.obj { as := S.τ (c i) }) :
    (S.contrFin1Fin1 c i j h).inv.hom (x ⊗ₜ[S.k] y) =
    PiTensorProduct.tprod S.k (fun k =>
    match k with | Sum.inl 0 => x | Sum.inr 0 => (S.FDiscrete.map
    (eqToHom (by simp [h]))).hom y)

entries.name: TensorSpecies.contrFin1Fin1_hom_hom_tprod
entries.snippet:
lemma contrFin1Fin1_hom_hom_tprod {n : ℕ} (c : Fin n.succ.succ → S.C)
    (i : Fin n.succ.succ) (j : Fin n.succ) (h : c (i.succAbove j) = S.τ (c i))
    (x : (k : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 1) → (S.FDiscrete.obj
      { as := (OverColor.mk ((c ∘ ⇑(HepLean.Fin.finExtractTwo i j).symm) ∘ Sum.inl)).hom k })) :
    (S.contrFin1Fin1 c i j h).hom.hom (PiTensorProduct.tprod S.k x) =
    x (Sum.inl 0) ⊗ₜ[S.k] ((S.FDiscrete.map (eqToHom (by simp [h]))).hom (x (Sum.inr 0)))

entries.name: TensorSpecies.contrIso
entries.docstring:
The isomorphism of objects in `Rep S.k S.G` given an `i` in `Fin n.succ.succ` and
  a `j` in `Fin n.succ` allowing us to undertake contraction.
entries.snippet:
def contrIso {n : ℕ} (c : Fin n.succ.succ → S.C)
    (i : Fin n.succ.succ) (j : Fin n.succ) (h : c (i.succAbove j) = S.τ (c i)) :
    S.F.obj (OverColor.mk c) ≅ ((OverColor.Discrete.pairτ S.FDiscrete S.τ).obj
      (Discrete.mk (c i))) ⊗
      (OverColor.lift.obj S.FDiscrete).obj (OverColor.mk (c ∘ i.succAbove ∘ j.succAbove))

entries.name: TensorSpecies.contrIso_hom_hom
entries.snippet:
lemma contrIso_hom_hom {n : ℕ} {c1 : Fin n.succ.succ → S.C}
    {i : Fin n.succ.succ} {j : Fin n.succ} {h : c1 (i.succAbove j) = S.τ (c1 i)} :
    (S.contrIso c1 i j h).hom.hom =
    (S.F.map (equivToIso (HepLean.Fin.finExtractTwo i j)).hom).hom ≫
    (S.F.map (mkSum (c1 ∘ ⇑(HepLean.Fin.finExtractTwo i j).symm)).hom).hom ≫
    (S.F.μIso (OverColor.mk ((c1 ∘ ⇑(HepLean.Fin.finExtractTwo i j).symm) ∘ Sum.inl))
    (OverColor.mk ((c1 ∘ ⇑(HepLean.Fin.finExtractTwo i j).symm) ∘ Sum.inr))).inv.hom ≫
    ((S.contrFin1Fin1 c1 i j h).hom.hom ⊗
    (S.F.map (mkIso (contrIso.proof_1 S c1 i j)).hom).hom)

entries.name: TensorSpecies.contrMap
entries.docstring:
`contrMap` is a function that takes a natural number `n`, a function `c` from
`Fin n.succ.succ` to `S.C`, an index `i` of type `Fin n.succ.succ`, an index `j` of type
`Fin n.succ`, and a proof `h` that `c (i.succAbove j) = S.τ (c i)`. It returns a morphism
corresponding to the contraction of the `i`th index with the `i.succAbove j` index.
-
entries.snippet:
def contrMap {n : ℕ} (c : Fin n.succ.succ → S.C)

entries.snippet:
lemma contrMap_tprod {n : ℕ} (c : Fin n.succ.succ → S.C)
    (i : Fin n.succ.succ) (j : Fin n.succ) (h : c (i.succAbove j) = S.τ (c i))
    (x : (i : Fin n.succ.succ) → S.FDiscrete.obj (Discrete.mk (c i))) :
    (S.contrMap c i j h).hom (PiTensorProduct.tprod S.k x) =
    (S.castToField ((S.contr.app (Discrete.mk (c i))).hom ((x i) ⊗ₜ[S.k]
    (S.FDiscrete.map (Discrete.eqToHom h)).hom (x (i.succAbove j)))) : S.k)
    • (PiTensorProduct.tprod S.k (fun k => x (i.succAbove (j.succAbove k))) :
    S.F.obj (OverColor.mk (c ∘ i.succAbove ∘ j.succAbove)))

    (S.evalIso c i).hom.hom (PiTensorProduct.tprod S.k x) =
    x i ⊗ₜ[S.k] (PiTensorProduct.tprod S.k (fun k => x (i.succAbove k)))

def evalLinearMap {n : ℕ} {c : Fin n.succ → S.C} (i : Fin n.succ) (e : Fin (S.repDim (c i))) :

entries.name: TensorSpecies.evalMap
entries.docstring:
The evaluation map, used to evaluate indices of tensors.
  Important Note: The evaluation map is in general, not equivariant with respect to
  group actions. It is a morphism in the underlying module category, not the category
  of representations.
entries.snippet:
def evalMap {n : ℕ} {c : Fin n.succ → S.C} (i : Fin n.succ) (e : Fin (S.repDim (c i))) :
    (S.F.obj (OverColor.mk c)).V ⟶ (S.F.obj (OverColor.mk (c ∘ i.succAbove))).V

entries.name: TensorSpecies.evalMap_tprod
entries.snippet:
lemma evalMap_tprod {n : ℕ} {c : Fin n.succ → S.C} (i : Fin n.succ) (e : Fin (S.repDim (c i)))
    (x : (i : Fin n.succ) → S.FDiscrete.obj (Discrete.mk (c i))) :
    (S.evalMap i e) (PiTensorProduct.tprod S.k x) =
    (((S.basis (c i)).repr (x i) e) : S.k) •
    (PiTensorProduct.tprod S.k
    (fun k => x (i.succAbove k)) : S.F.obj (OverColor.mk (c ∘ i.succAbove)))

entries.name: TensorTree
entries.docstring: A syntax tree for tensor expressions.
entries.snippet:
inductive TensorTree (S : TensorSpecies) : {n : ℕ} → (Fin n → S.C) → Type where
  | tensorNode {n : ℕ} {c : Fin n → S.C} (T : S.F.obj (OverColor.mk c)) : TensorTree S c
  | add {n : ℕ} {c : Fin n → S.C} : TensorTree S c → TensorTree S c → TensorTree S c
  | perm {n m : ℕ} {c : Fin n → S.C} {c1 : Fin m → S.C}
      (σ : (OverColor.mk c) ⟶ (OverColor.mk c1)) (t : TensorTree S c) : TensorTree S c1
  | prod {n m : ℕ} {c : Fin n → S.C} {c1 : Fin m → S.C}
    (t : TensorTree S c) (t1 : TensorTree S c1) : TensorTree S (Sum.elim c c1 ∘ finSumFinEquiv.symm)
  | smul {n : ℕ} {c : Fin n → S.C} : S.k → TensorTree S c → TensorTree S c
  | neg {n : ℕ} {c : Fin n → S.C} : TensorTree S c → TensorTree S c
  | contr {n : ℕ} {c : Fin n.succ.succ → S.C} : (i : Fin n.succ.succ) →
    (j : Fin n.succ) → (h : c (i.succAbove j) = S.τ (c i)) → TensorTree S c →
    TensorTree S (c ∘ Fin.succAbove i ∘ Fin.succAbove j)
  | action {n : ℕ} {c : Fin n → S.C} : S.G → TensorTree S c → TensorTree S c
  | eval {n : ℕ} {c : Fin n.succ → S.C} : (i : Fin n.succ) → (x : ℕ) → TensorTree S c →
    TensorTree S (c ∘ Fin.succAbove i)

entries.docstring:
A structure containing two pairs of indices (i, j) and (k, l) to be sequentially
  contracted in a tensor.

structure ContrQuartet {n : ℕ} (c : Fin n.succ.succ.succ.succ → S.C) where

entries.name: TensorTree.ContrQuartet.contrSwapHom_contrMapSnd_tprod
entries.snippet:
lemma contrSwapHom_contrMapSnd_tprod (x : (i : (𝟭 Type).obj (OverColor.mk c).left) →
    CoeSort.coe (S.FDiscrete.obj { as := (OverColor.mk c).hom i })) :
    ((lift.obj S.FDiscrete).map q.contrSwapHom).hom
    (q.swap.contrMapSnd.hom ((PiTensorProduct.tprod S.k) fun k =>
    x (q.swap.i.succAbove (q.swap.j.succAbove k)))) = ((S.castToField
    ((S.contr.app { as := (c ∘ q.swap.i.succAbove ∘ q.swap.j.succAbove) q.swap.k }).hom
    (x (q.swap.i.succAbove (q.swap.j.succAbove q.swap.k)) ⊗ₜ[S.k]
    (S.FDiscrete.map (Discrete.eqToHom q.swap.hkl)).hom
    (x (q.swap.i.succAbove (q.swap.j.succAbove (q.swap.k.succAbove q.swap.l))))))) •
    ((lift.obj S.FDiscrete).map q.contrSwapHom).hom ((PiTensorProduct.tprod S.k) fun k =>
    x (q.swap.i.succAbove (q.swap.j.succAbove (q.swap.k.succAbove (q.swap.l.succAbove k))))))

    ((PiTensorProduct.tprod S.k)
    fun k => x (q.i.succAbove (q.j.succAbove (q.k.succAbove (q.l.succAbove k))))) =
    ((lift.obj S.FDiscrete).map q.contrSwapHom).hom
    ((PiTensorProduct.tprod S.k) fun k =>
      x (q.swap.i.succAbove (q.swap.j.succAbove (q.swap.k.succAbove (q.swap.l.succAbove k)))))

entries.name: TensorTree.contrContrPerm
entries.docstring:
The homomorphism one must apply on swapping the order of contractions.
  This is identical to `ContrQuartet.contrSwapHom` except manifestly between the correct
  types.
entries.snippet:
def contrContrPerm {n : ℕ} {c : Fin n.succ.succ.succ.succ → S.C} {i : Fin n.succ.succ.succ.succ}
    {j : Fin n.succ.succ.succ} {k : Fin n.succ.succ} {l : Fin n.succ}
    (hij : c (i.succAbove j) = S.τ (c i)) (hkl : (c ∘ i.succAbove ∘ j.succAbove) (k.succAbove l) =
    S.τ ((c ∘ i.succAbove ∘ j.succAbove) k)) :
    OverColor.mk ((c ∘ (ContrQuartet.mk i j k l hij hkl).swapI.succAbove ∘
      (ContrQuartet.mk i j k l hij hkl).swapJ.succAbove) ∘
      (ContrQuartet.mk i j k l hij hkl).swapK.succAbove ∘
      (ContrQuartet.mk i j k l hij hkl).swapL.succAbove) ⟶
    OverColor.mk
      ((c ∘ i.succAbove ∘ j.succAbove) ∘ k.succAbove ∘ l.succAbove)

entries.name: TensorTree.contr_contr
entries.docstring: Contraction nodes commute on adjusting indices.
entries.snippet:
theorem contr_contr {n : ℕ} {c : Fin n.succ.succ.succ.succ → S.C} {i : Fin n.succ.succ.succ.succ}
    {j : Fin n.succ.succ.succ} {k : Fin n.succ.succ} {l : Fin n.succ}
    (hij : c (i.succAbove j) = S.τ (c i)) (hkl : (c ∘ i.succAbove ∘ j.succAbove) (k.succAbove l) =
    S.τ ((c ∘ i.succAbove ∘ j.succAbove) k))
    (t : TensorTree S c) :
    (contr k l hkl (contr i j hij t)).tensor =
    (perm (contrContrPerm hij hkl)
    (contr (ContrQuartet.mk i j k l hij hkl).swapK (ContrQuartet.mk i j k l hij hkl).swapL
    (ContrQuartet.mk i j k l hij hkl).swap.hkl (contr (ContrQuartet.mk i j k l hij hkl).swapI
    (ContrQuartet.mk i j k l hij hkl).swapJ
    (ContrQuartet.mk i j k l hij hkl).swap.hij t))).tensor

theorem contr_swap {n : ℕ} {c : Fin n.succ.succ → S.C} {i : Fin n.succ.succ}

entries.name: TensorSpecies.contrFin1Fin1_naturality
entries.snippet:
lemma contrFin1Fin1_naturality {n : ℕ} {c c1 : Fin n.succ.succ → S.C}
    {i : Fin n.succ.succ} {j : Fin n.succ} (h : c1 (i.succAbove j) = S.τ (c1 i))
    (σ : (OverColor.mk c) ⟶ (OverColor.mk c1)) :
    (S.F.map (extractTwoAux' i j σ)).hom ≫ (S.contrFin1Fin1 c1 i j h).hom.hom
    = (S.contrFin1Fin1 c ((Hom.toEquiv σ).symm i)
      ((HepLean.Fin.finExtractOnePerm ((Hom.toEquiv σ).symm i) (Hom.toEquiv σ)).symm j)
      (perm_contr_cond S h σ)).hom.hom
    ≫ ((Discrete.pairτ S.FDiscrete S.τ).map (Discrete.eqToHom (Hom.toEquiv_comp_inv_apply σ i) :
      (Discrete.mk (c ((Hom.toEquiv σ).symm i))) ⟶ (Discrete.mk (c1 i)))).hom

entries.name: TensorSpecies.contrIso_comm_aux_1
entries.snippet:
lemma contrIso_comm_aux_1 {n : ℕ} {c c1 : Fin n.succ.succ → S.C}
    {i : Fin n.succ.succ} {j : Fin n.succ}
    (σ : (OverColor.mk c) ⟶ (OverColor.mk c1)) :
    ((S.F.map σ).hom ≫ (S.F.map (equivToIso (HepLean.Fin.finExtractTwo i j)).hom).hom) ≫
        (S.F.map (mkSum (c1 ∘ ⇑(HepLean.Fin.finExtractTwo i j).symm)).hom).hom =
    (S.F.map (equivToIso (HepLean.Fin.finExtractTwo ((Hom.toEquiv σ).symm i)
    ((HepLean.Fin.finExtractOnePerm ((Hom.toEquiv σ).symm i) (Hom.toEquiv σ)).symm j))).hom).hom ≫
    (S.F.map (mkSum (c ∘ ⇑(HepLean.Fin.finExtractTwo ((Hom.toEquiv σ).symm i)
    ((HepLean.Fin.finExtractOnePerm
    ((Hom.toEquiv σ).symm i) (Hom.toEquiv σ)).symm j)).symm)).hom).hom
    ≫ (S.F.map (extractTwoAux' i j σ ⊗ extractTwoAux i j σ)).hom

entries.name: TensorSpecies.contrIso_comm_aux_2
entries.snippet:
lemma contrIso_comm_aux_2 {n : ℕ} {c c1 : Fin n.succ.succ → S.C}
    {i : Fin n.succ.succ} {j : Fin n.succ}
    (σ : (OverColor.mk c) ⟶ (OverColor.mk c1)) :
    (S.F.map (extractTwoAux' i j σ ⊗ extractTwoAux i j σ)).hom ≫
    (S.F.μIso (OverColor.mk ((c1 ∘ ⇑(HepLean.Fin.finExtractTwo i j).symm) ∘ Sum.inl))
    (OverColor.mk ((c1 ∘ ⇑(HepLean.Fin.finExtractTwo i j).symm) ∘ Sum.inr))).inv.hom =
    (S.F.μIso _ _).inv.hom ≫
    (S.F.map (extractTwoAux' i j σ) ⊗ S.F.map (extractTwoAux i j σ)).hom

entries.name: TensorSpecies.contrIso_comm_aux_3
entries.snippet:
lemma contrIso_comm_aux_3 {n : ℕ} {c c1 : Fin n.succ.succ → S.C}
    {i : Fin n.succ.succ} {j : Fin n.succ}
    (σ : (OverColor.mk c) ⟶ (OverColor.mk c1)) :
      ((Action.functorCategoryEquivalence (ModuleCat S.k) (MonCat.of S.G)).symm.inverse.map
                  (S.F.map (extractTwoAux i j σ))).app
              PUnit.unit ≫
            (S.F.map (mkIso (contrIso.proof_1 S c1 i j)).hom).hom
    = (S.F.map (mkIso (contrIso.proof_1 S c ((Hom.toEquiv σ).symm i)
    ((HepLean.Fin.finExtractOnePerm ((Hom.toEquiv σ).symm i) (Hom.toEquiv σ)).symm j))).hom).hom ≫
    (S.F.map (extractTwo i j σ)).hom

entries.name: TensorSpecies.contrIsoComm
entries.docstring: A helper function used to proof the relation between perm and contr.
entries.snippet:
def contrIsoComm {n : ℕ} {c c1 : Fin n.succ.succ → S.C}
    {i : Fin n.succ.succ} {j : Fin n.succ} (σ : (OverColor.mk c) ⟶ (OverColor.mk c1))

entries.name: TensorSpecies.contrIso_comm_aux_5
entries.snippet:
lemma contrIso_comm_aux_5 {n : ℕ} {c c1 : Fin n.succ.succ → S.C}
    {i : Fin n.succ.succ} {j : Fin n.succ} (h : c1 (i.succAbove j) = S.τ (c1 i))
    (σ : (OverColor.mk c) ⟶ (OverColor.mk c1)) :
    (S.F.map (extractTwoAux' i j σ) ⊗ S.F.map (extractTwoAux i j σ)).hom ≫
    ((S.contrFin1Fin1 c1 i j h).hom.hom ⊗ (S.F.map (mkIso (contrIso.proof_1 S c1 i j)).hom).hom)
    = ((S.contrFin1Fin1 c ((Hom.toEquiv σ).symm i)
    ((HepLean.Fin.finExtractOnePerm ((Hom.toEquiv σ).symm i) (Hom.toEquiv σ)).symm j)
    (perm_contr_cond S h σ)).hom.hom ⊗
    (S.F.map (mkIso (contrIso.proof_1 S c ((Hom.toEquiv σ).symm i)
    ((HepLean.Fin.finExtractOnePerm ((Hom.toEquiv σ).symm i) (Hom.toEquiv σ)).symm j))).hom).hom)
    ≫ (S.contrIsoComm σ).hom

TensorSpecies.contrMap_naturality
entries.docstring: Contraction commutes with `S.F.map σ` on removing corresponding indices from `σ`.
entries.snippet:
lemma contrMap_naturality {n : ℕ} {c c1 : Fin n.succ.succ → S.C}
    {i : Fin n.succ.succ} {j : Fin n.succ} {h : c1 (i.succAbove j) = S.τ (c1 i)}
    (σ : (OverColor.mk c) ⟶ (OverColor.mk c1)) :
    (S.F.map σ) ≫ (S.contrMap c1 i j h) =
    (S.contrMap c ((OverColor.Hom.toEquiv σ).symm i)
    (((Hom.toEquiv (extractOne i σ))).symm j) (S.perm_contr_cond h σ)) ≫
    (S.F.map (extractTwo i j σ))

entries.name: TensorTree.perm_contr
entries.docstring:
Permuting indices, and then contracting is equivalent to contracting and then permuting,
  once care is taking about ensuring one is contracting the same idices.
entries.snippet:
lemma perm_contr {n : ℕ} {c : Fin n.succ.succ → S.C} {c1 : Fin n.succ.succ → S.C}
    {i : Fin n.succ.succ} {j : Fin n.succ}
    {h : c1 (i.succAbove j) = S.τ (c1 i)} (t : TensorTree S c)
    (σ : (OverColor.mk c) ⟶ (OverColor.mk c1)) :
    (contr i j h (perm σ t)).tensor
    = (perm (extractTwo i j σ) (contr ((Hom.toEquiv σ).symm i)
    (((Hom.toEquiv (extractOne i σ))).symm j) (S.perm_contr_cond h σ) t)).tensor

TensorTree.perm_contr_congr_contr_cond

TensorTree.permProdLeft
entries.docstring:
The permutation that arises when moving a `perm` node in the left entry through a `prod` node.
  This permutation is defined using right-whiskering and composition with `finSumFinEquiv`
  based-isomorphisms.
entries.snippet: def permProdLeft

entries.name: TensorTree.permProdRight
entries.docstring:
The permutation that arises when moving a `perm` node in the right entry through a `prod` node.
  This permutation is defined using left-whiskering and composition with `finSumFinEquiv`
  based-isomorphisms.
entries.snippet: def permProdRight

entries.name: TensorTree.prod_perm_left
entries.docstring:
When a `prod` acts on a `perm` node in the left entry, the `perm` node can be moved through
  the `prod` node via right-whiskering.
entries.snippet:
theorem prod_perm_left (t : TensorTree S c) (t2 : TensorTree S c2) :
    (prod (perm σ t) t2).tensor = (perm (permProdLeft c2 σ) (prod t t2)).tensor

entries.name: TensorTree.prod_perm_right
entries.docstring:
When a `prod` acts on a `perm` node in the right entry, the `perm` node can be moved through
  the `prod` node via left-whiskering.
entries.snippet:
theorem prod_perm_right (t2 : TensorTree S c2) (t : TensorTree S c) :
    (prod t2 (perm σ t)).tensor = (perm (permProdRight c2 σ) (prod t2 t)).tensor

entries.name: TensorTree.assocPerm
entries.docstring:
The permutation that arises from assocativity of `prod` node.
  This permutation is defined using braiding and composition with `finSumFinEquiv`
  based-isomorphisms.
entries.snippet:
def assocPerm : OverColor.mk
    (Sum.elim (Sum.elim c c2 ∘ ⇑finSumFinEquiv.symm) c3 ∘ ⇑finSumFinEquiv.symm) ≅
    OverColor.mk (Sum.elim c (Sum.elim c2 c3 ∘ ⇑finSumFinEquiv.symm) ∘ ⇑finSumFinEquiv.symm)

entries.name: TensorTree.finSumFinEquiv_comp_assocPerm
entries.snippet:
lemma finSumFinEquiv_comp_assocPerm :
    (equivToIso finSumFinEquiv).hom ≫ (assocPerm c c2 c3).hom =
    (whiskerRightIso (equivToIso finSumFinEquiv).symm (OverColor.mk c3)).hom ≫
    (α_ (OverColor.mk c) (OverColor.mk c2) (OverColor.mk c3)).hom ≫
    (whiskerLeftIso (OverColor.mk c) (equivToIso finSumFinEquiv)).hom
    ≫ (equivToIso finSumFinEquiv).hom

entries.name: TensorTree.prod_assoc
entries.docstring: The `prod` obeys associativity.
entries.snippet:
theorem prod_assoc (t : TensorTree S c) (t2 : TensorTree S c2) (t3 : TensorTree S c3) :
    (prod t (prod t2 t3)).tensor = (perm (assocPerm c c2 c3).hom (prod (prod t t2) t3)).tensor

entries.name: TensorTree.prod_assoc'
entries.docstring:
The alternative version of associativity for `prod` where the permutation is on the opposite
  side.
entries.snippet:
lemma prod_assoc' (t : TensorTree S c) (t2 : TensorTree S c2) (t3 : TensorTree S c3) :
    (prod (prod t t2) t3).tensor = (perm (assocPerm c c2 c3).inv (prod t (prod t2 t3))).tensor

entries.name: TensorTree.braidPerm
entries.docstring:
The permutation that arises when moving a commuting terms in a `prod` node.
  This permutation is defined using braiding and composition with `finSumFinEquiv`
  based-isomorphisms.
entries.snippet:
def braidPerm : OverColor.mk (Sum.elim c2 c ∘ ⇑finSumFinEquiv.symm) ⟶
    OverColor.mk (Sum.elim c c2 ∘ ⇑finSumFinEquiv.symm)

entries.name: TensorTree.finSumFinEquiv_comp_braidPerm
entries.snippet:
lemma finSumFinEquiv_comp_braidPerm :
    (equivToIso finSumFinEquiv).hom ≫ braidPerm c c2 =
    (β_ (OverColor.mk c2) (OverColor.mk c)).hom
    ≫ (equivToIso finSumFinEquiv).hom

entries.name: TensorTree.prod_comm
entries.docstring: The arguments of a `prod` node can be commuted using braiding.
entries.snippet:
theorem prod_comm (t : TensorTree S c) (t2 : TensorTree S c2) :
    (prod t t2).tensor = (perm (braidPerm c c2) (prod t2 t)).tensor

entries.name: TensorTree.ContrPair.leftContrEquivSuccSucc
entries.docstring:
An equivalence needed to perform contraction. For specified `n` and `n1`

entries.snippet: def leftContrEquivSuccSucc : Fin (n.succ.succ + n1) ≃ Fin ((n + n1).succ.succ)

entries.name: TensorTree.ContrPair.leftContrEquivSucc
entries.docstring:
An equivalence needed to perform contraction. For specified `n` and `n1`
  this reduces to an identity.
entries.snippet: def leftContrEquivSucc : Fin (n.succ + n1) ≃ Fin ((n + n1).succ)

entries.name: TensorTree.ContrPair.leftContrI
entries.docstring:
The new fst index of a contraction obtained on moving a contraction in the LHS of a product

entries.snippet: def leftContrI (n1 : ℕ) : Fin ((n + n1).succ.succ)

entries.name: TensorTree.ContrPair.leftContrJ
entries.docstring:
The new snd index of a contraction obtained on moving a contraction in the LHS of a product

entries.snippet: def leftContrJ (n1 : ℕ) : Fin ((n + n1).succ)

entries.name: TensorTree.ContrPair.leftContrJ_succAbove_leftContrI
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma leftContrJ_succAbove_leftContrI : (q.leftContrI n1).succAbove (q.leftContrJ n1)
    = leftContrEquivSuccSucc (Fin.castAdd n1 (q.i.succAbove q.j))

entries.name: TensorTree.ContrPair.succAbove_leftContrJ_leftContrI_castAdd
entries.snippet:
lemma succAbove_leftContrJ_leftContrI_castAdd (x : Fin n) :
    (q.leftContrI n1).succAbove ((q.leftContrJ n1).succAbove (Fin.castAdd n1 x)) =
    leftContrEquivSuccSucc (Fin.castAdd n1 (q.i.succAbove (q.j.succAbove x)))

entries.name: TensorTree.ContrPair.succAbove_leftContrJ_leftContrI_natAdd
entries.snippet:
lemma succAbove_leftContrJ_leftContrI_natAdd (x : Fin n1) :
    (q.leftContrI n1).succAbove ((q.leftContrJ n1).succAbove (Fin.natAdd n x)) =
    leftContrEquivSuccSucc (Fin.natAdd n.succ.succ x)

entries.name: TensorTree.ContrPair.leftContr
entries.docstring:
The pair of contraction indices obtained on moving a contraction in the LHS of a product
  through the product.
entries.snippet:
def leftContr : ContrPair ((Sum.elim c c1 ∘ (@finSumFinEquiv n.succ.succ n1).symm.toFun) ∘
    leftContrEquivSuccSucc.symm) where

entries.name: TensorTree.ContrPair.leftContr_map_eq
entries.snippet:
lemma leftContr_map_eq : ((Sum.elim c (OverColor.mk c1).hom ∘ finSumFinEquiv.symm.toFun) ∘
    ⇑leftContrEquivSuccSucc.symm) ∘ (q.leftContr (c1 := c1)).i.succAbove ∘
    (q.leftContr (c1 := c1)).j.succAbove =
    Sum.elim (OverColor.mk (c ∘ q.i.succAbove ∘ q.j.succAbove)).hom (OverColor.mk c1).hom ∘
    ⇑finSumFinEquiv.symm

entries.name: TensorTree.ContrPair.sum_inl_succAbove_leftContrI_leftContrJ
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_inl_succAbove_leftContrI_leftContrJ (k : Fin n) : finSumFinEquiv.symm
    (leftContrEquivSuccSucc.symm
    ((q.leftContr (c1 := c1)).i.succAbove
    ((q.leftContr (c1 := c1)).j.succAbove
    ((finSumFinEquiv (Sum.inl k)))))) =
  Sum.map (q.i.succAbove ∘ q.j.succAbove) id (Sum.inl k)

entries.name: TensorTree.ContrPair.sum_inr_succAbove_leftContrI_leftContrJ
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_inr_succAbove_leftContrI_leftContrJ (k : Fin n1) : finSumFinEquiv.symm
    (leftContrEquivSuccSucc.symm ((q.leftContr (c1 := c1)).i.succAbove
    ((q.leftContr (c1 := c1)).j.succAbove ((finSumFinEquiv (Sum.inr k)))))) =
    Sum.map (q.i.succAbove ∘ q.j.succAbove) id (Sum.inr k)

entries.name: TensorTree.ContrPair.contrMap_prod_tprod
entries.snippet:
lemma contrMap_prod_tprod (p : (i : (𝟭 Type).obj (OverColor.mk c).left) →
    CoeSort.coe (S.FDiscrete.obj { as := (OverColor.mk c).hom i }))
    (q' : (i : (𝟭 Type).obj (OverColor.mk c1).left) →
      CoeSort.coe (S.FDiscrete.obj { as := (OverColor.mk c1).hom i })) :
    (S.F.map (equivToIso finSumFinEquiv).hom).hom
    ((S.F.μ (OverColor.mk (c ∘ q.i.succAbove ∘ q.j.succAbove)) (OverColor.mk c1)).hom
    ((q.contrMap.hom (PiTensorProduct.tprod S.k p)) ⊗ₜ[S.k] (PiTensorProduct.tprod S.k) q'))
    = (S.F.map (mkIso (by exact leftContr_map_eq q)).hom).hom
    (q.leftContr.contrMap.hom
    ((S.F.map (equivToIso (@leftContrEquivSuccSucc n n1)).hom).hom
    ((S.F.map (equivToIso finSumFinEquiv).hom).hom
    ((S.F.μ (OverColor.mk c) (OverColor.mk c1)).hom
    ((PiTensorProduct.tprod S.k) p ⊗ₜ[S.k] (PiTensorProduct.tprod S.k) q')))))

entries.name: TensorTree.ContrPair.contrMap_prod
entries.snippet:
lemma contrMap_prod :
    (q.contrMap ▷ S.F.obj (OverColor.mk c1)) ≫ (S.F.μ _ ((OverColor.mk c1))) ≫
    S.F.map (OverColor.equivToIso finSumFinEquiv).hom =
    (S.F.μ ((OverColor.mk c)) ((OverColor.mk c1))) ≫
    S.F.map (OverColor.equivToIso finSumFinEquiv).hom ≫
    S.F.map (OverColor.equivToIso leftContrEquivSuccSucc).hom ≫ q.leftContr.contrMap
    ≫ S.F.map (OverColor.mkIso (q.leftContr_map_eq)).hom

entries.name: TensorTree.ContrPair.contr_prod
entries.snippet:
lemma contr_prod
    (t : TensorTree S c) (t1 : TensorTree S c1) :
    (prod (contr q.i q.j q.h t) t1).tensor = ((perm (OverColor.mkIso q.leftContr_map_eq).hom
    (contr (q.leftContrI n1) (q.leftContrJ n1)
    q.leftContr.h
    (perm (OverColor.equivToIso ContrPair.leftContrEquivSuccSucc).hom (prod t t1)))).tensor)

entries.name: TensorTree.ContrPair.rightContrI

The new fst index of a contraction obtained on moving a contraction in the RHS of a product

entries.snippet: def rightContrI (n1 : ℕ) : Fin ((n1 + n).succ.succ)

entries.name: TensorTree.ContrPair.rightContrJ

The new snd index of a contraction obtained on moving a contraction in the RHS of a product

entries.name: TensorTree.ContrPair.rightContrJ_succAbove_rightContrI

@[simp]
lemma rightContrJ_succAbove_rightContrI : (q.rightContrI n1).succAbove (q.rightContrJ n1)

entries.name: TensorTree.ContrPair.succAbove_rightContrJ_rightContrI_castAdd

lemma succAbove_rightContrJ_rightContrI_castAdd (x : Fin n1) :

entries.name: TensorTree.ContrPair.rightContr
entries.docstring:
The new pair of indices obtained on moving a contraction in the RHS of a product
  through the product.
entries.snippet: def rightContr : ContrPair ((Sum.elim c1 c ∘ (@finSumFinEquiv n1 n.succ.succ).symm.toFun)) where

entries.name: TensorTree.ContrPair.rightContr_map_eq
entries.snippet:
lemma rightContr_map_eq : ((Sum.elim c1 (OverColor.mk c).hom ∘ finSumFinEquiv.symm.toFun)) ∘
    (q.rightContr (c1 := c1)).i.succAbove ∘ (q.rightContr (c1 := c1)).j.succAbove =
    Sum.elim (OverColor.mk c1).hom (OverColor.mk (c ∘ q.i.succAbove ∘ q.j.succAbove)).hom ∘
    ⇑finSumFinEquiv.symm

entries.name: TensorTree.ContrPair.sum_inl_succAbove_rightContrI_rightContrJ
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_inl_succAbove_rightContrI_rightContrJ (k : Fin n1) : (@finSumFinEquiv n1 n.succ.succ).symm
    ((q.rightContr (c1 := c1)).i.succAbove
      ((q.rightContr (c1 := c1)).j.succAbove (((@finSumFinEquiv n1 n) (Sum.inl k))))) =
    Sum.map id (q.i.succAbove ∘ q.j.succAbove)
    (finSumFinEquiv.symm (finSumFinEquiv (Sum.inl k)))

entries.name: TensorTree.ContrPair.sum_inr_succAbove_rightContrI_rightContrJ
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_inr_succAbove_rightContrI_rightContrJ (k : Fin n) : (@finSumFinEquiv n1 n.succ.succ).symm
    ((q.rightContr (c1 := c1)).i.succAbove
    ((q.rightContr (c1 := c1)).j.succAbove ((finSumFinEquiv (Sum.inr k))))) =
    Sum.map id (q.i.succAbove ∘ q.j.succAbove)
    (finSumFinEquiv.symm (finSumFinEquiv (Sum.inr k)))

entries.name: TensorTree.ContrPair.prod_contrMap_tprod
entries.snippet:
lemma prod_contrMap_tprod (p : (i : (𝟭 Type).obj (OverColor.mk c1).left) →
    CoeSort.coe (S.FDiscrete.obj { as := (OverColor.mk c1).hom i }))
    (q' : (i : (𝟭 Type).obj (OverColor.mk c).left) →
      CoeSort.coe (S.FDiscrete.obj { as := (OverColor.mk c).hom i })) :
    (S.F.map (equivToIso finSumFinEquiv).hom).hom
    ((S.F.μ (OverColor.mk c1) (OverColor.mk (c ∘ q.i.succAbove ∘ q.j.succAbove))).hom
    ((PiTensorProduct.tprod S.k) p ⊗ₜ[S.k] (q.contrMap.hom (PiTensorProduct.tprod S.k q')))) =
    (S.F.map (mkIso (by exact (rightContr_map_eq q))).hom).hom
    (q.rightContr.contrMap.hom
    (((S.F.map (equivToIso finSumFinEquiv).hom).hom
    ((S.F.μ (OverColor.mk c1) (OverColor.mk c)).hom
    ((PiTensorProduct.tprod S.k) p ⊗ₜ[S.k] (PiTensorProduct.tprod S.k) q')))))

entries.name: TensorTree.ContrPair.prod_contrMap
entries.snippet:
lemma prod_contrMap :
    (S.F.obj (OverColor.mk c1) ◁ q.contrMap) ≫ (S.F.μ ((OverColor.mk c1)) _) ≫
    S.F.map (OverColor.equivToIso finSumFinEquiv).hom =
    (S.F.μ ((OverColor.mk c1)) ((OverColor.mk c))) ≫
    S.F.map (OverColor.equivToIso finSumFinEquiv).hom ≫
    q.rightContr.contrMap ≫ S.F.map (OverColor.mkIso (q.rightContr_map_eq)).hom

entries.name: TensorTree.ContrPair.prod_contr
entries.snippet:
lemma prod_contr (t1 : TensorTree S c1) (t : TensorTree S c) :
    (prod t1 (contr q.i q.j q.h t)).tensor = ((perm (OverColor.mkIso q.rightContr_map_eq).hom
    (contr (q.rightContrI n1) (q.rightContrJ n1)
    q.rightContr.h (prod t1 t))).tensor)

entries.name: TensorTree.contr_prod
entries.docstring: Contraction in the LHS of a product can be moved out of that product.
entries.snippet:
theorem contr_prod {n n1 : ℕ} {c : Fin n.succ.succ → S.C} {c1 : Fin n1 → S.C} {i : Fin n.succ.succ}
    {j : Fin n.succ} (hij : c (i.succAbove j) = S.τ (c i))
    (t : TensorTree S c) (t1 : TensorTree S c1) :
    (prod (contr i j hij t) t1).tensor =
    ((perm (OverColor.mkIso (ContrPair.mk i j hij).leftContr_map_eq).hom
    (contr ((ContrPair.mk i j hij).leftContrI n1) ((ContrPair.mk i j hij).leftContrJ n1)
    (ContrPair.mk i j hij).leftContr.h
    (perm (OverColor.equivToIso ContrPair.leftContrEquivSuccSucc).hom (prod t t1)))).tensor)

entries.name: TensorTree.prod_contr
entries.docstring: Contraction in the RHS of a product can be moved out of that product.
entries.snippet:
theorem prod_contr {n n1 : ℕ} {c : Fin n.succ.succ → S.C} {c1 : Fin n1 → S.C} {i : Fin n.succ.succ}
    {j : Fin n.succ} (hij : c (i.succAbove j) = S.τ (c i))
    (t1 : TensorTree S c1) (t : TensorTree S c) :
    (prod t1 (contr i j hij t)).tensor =
    ((perm (OverColor.mkIso (ContrPair.mk i j hij).rightContr_map_eq).hom
    (contr ((ContrPair.mk i j hij).rightContrI n1) ((ContrPair.mk i j hij).rightContrJ n1)
    (ContrPair.mk i j hij).rightContr.h (prod t1 t))).tensor)
